programme.title: It's the End of the World as We Know It and What Were We Talking About?
programme.desc: Flower tries to cancel the opening of Jay's restaurant because it's the same day as the "end of the world."

programme.title: Ghostfellas
programme.desc: Jay is in a tiff with the mafia after Pete shares a recipe that Jay puts on the menu at his restaurant.

programme.title: Alexander Hamilton and the Ruffle Kerfuffle
programme.desc: We finally learn the root cause of Isaac's rivalry with Hamilton. Hetty's ex-husband, Elias, returns from hell

programme.title: The Bachelorette Party
programme.desc: Alberta questions her descendant's fiancé during a bachelorette party at Woodstone Mansion.

programme.title: St. Hetty's Day
programme.desc: Hetty's ghost power is finally revealed. Isaac tries to connect with Chris, the recently-dead stripper ghost.

programme.title: His Girl Shiki
programme.desc: Pete sets Sasappis up with a wisecracking 1940s ghost. Thor decides to "revenge bail" on Alberta's party.

programme.title: Smooching and Smushing
programme.desc: Sasappis enlists the help of Sam and Jay to repair the ghost trap to try to get him across the boundary.

programme.title: Pinkus Returns
programme.desc: Trevor is thrilled when his former co-worker, Pinkus, shows up. Pinkus reveals a secret he's been keeping.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Thirty Seven Summers Ago
programme.desc: Hoping to expedite some permits, Sam and Jay host a fundraiser for the mayor of their small town.

programme.title: Kyle
programme.desc: A handsome living who can see ghosts arrives at Woodstone B&B.

programme.title: The Devil Went Down to Woodstone
programme.desc: Sam and Jay host a big party for the launch of Sam and Isaac's vampire book.

programme.title: Soul Custody
programme.desc: Sam, Jay and the ghosts try to find a way to save Jay's life and extricate him from his deal with the devil.

programme.title: Viking Wedding
programme.desc: Sam and Jay's attempt to befriend some new neighbors collides with an awkward demand from Thorfinn.

programme.title: Halloween 5: The Mummy

programme.title: Bring Your Daughter to Work Day

programme.title: T-Daddy
programme.desc: A mistake by Sam results in an argument between Trevor and his daughter.

programme.title: Planes, Shanes and Automobiles
programme.desc: Sam and Pete's attempt to get home for Thanksgiving is jeopardized when they get stranded after a book signing

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: Sam helps Eric plan a proposal for Bela, until an encounter with Sasappis plants doubt in Bela's mind.

programme.title: The Life and Times of Esther Greene
programme.desc: Now a big podcaster, Todd Pearlman returns to profile Sam and Isaac's book, but becomes obsessed with Jay.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Christmas Carol: Part 1
programme.desc: An unfortunate holiday tradition threatens to derail an important opportunity for Sam.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Christmas Carol: Part 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this holiday double header, a visitor from the recent past returns to grant Sam a Christmas wish.

programme.title: The Others
programme.desc: Jay and Sam's trip to Bimini is threatened when Patience introduces the ghosts to her friends from the dirt.

programme.title: The List
programme.desc: Sam and Jay work to secure a coveted spot on a prestigious luxury hotel list, only to face unexpected chaos.

programme.title: Hetty's Day 2: The Help
programme.desc: Hetty, trying to make the most of her ability to be seen on St. Patrick's Day, wreaks havoc at the restaurant.

programme.title: The Water Heater
programme.desc: Sam and Jay try to replace their broken water heater, but Isaac turns the upgrade into a campaign issue.

programme.title: Michael Jackson Goes to HR

programme.title: Woodstone Royale
programme.desc: Needing to raise a large sum of money to pay the IRS, Sam and Jay agree to host a high-stakes poker game.

programme.title: The Investor
programme.desc: A deal to save Woodstone hits a snag when it's revealed that the investor has major beef with Mark.

programme.title: Under New Management
programme.desc: Sam and Jay face new threats against their control of the B&B, forcing them to tackle unexpected challenges.

programme.title: Gate-gate
programme.desc: When an emotion-driven decision puts Woodstone at risk, Sam and Jay step up to defend what they've built.

programme.title: Polar Opposites
programme.desc: A Hollywood producer scouts Woodstone for filming, inspiring Sam to take a creative risk.

programme.title: Up the Creek
programme.desc: When Woodstone's future is put in jeopardy, Sam and Jay join forces with the ghosts to protect the mansion.

programme.title: Across the Pond
programme.desc: A trip abroad could determine Woodstone's fate.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: A couple convert a rundown estate into a B&B - only to find it's haunted by the spirits of deceased residents.

programme.title: Hello!
programme.desc: Sam tries to ignore the ghosts, making them even more determined to get her to acknowledge they're real.

programme.title: Viking Funeral
programme.desc: When Thorfinn's bones are discovered, he asks Sam for a traditional Viking funeral.

programme.title: Dinner Party
programme.desc: When Sam and Jay invite the nosy neighbors to a dinner party, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: On Halloween, the ghosts try to help protect the manor from the kids who annually vandalize the house.

programme.title: Pete's Wife
programme.desc: Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret

programme.title: Flower's Article
programme.desc: Flower begs Sam not to write about the time she and her friends held up a bank during her commune days.

programme.title: D&D
programme.desc: Sam agrees to facilitate a new Dungeons & Dragons campaign between Jay and the ghosts.

programme.title: Alberta's Fan
programme.desc: Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion.

programme.title: Possession
programme.desc: Hetty possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are to about show Woodstone Mansion to a wedding planner.

programme.title: Sam's Mom
programme.desc: Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother died to see if she's a ghost.

programme.title: Jay's Sister
programme.desc: Jay and Sam are shocked to discover that Jay's sister is communicating with someone they know on a dating app.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Just as Sam and Jay are about to host a friend's wedding, the ghost of Hetty's husband tries to ruin it.

programme.title: Ghostwriter

programme.title: Trevor's Pants
programme.desc: The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion.

programme.title: Attic Girl
programme.desc: An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie, who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic.

programme.title: Postmarked for Death
programme.desc: The sheriff investigates after a postmaster is gunned down during a mail run.

programme.title: Ordeal
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel across the desert, returning from a trip to lay in a supply of salt.

programme.title: The Spiked Rifle
programme.desc: Stagecoach robbers hold Mark hostage.

programme.title: Letter to the Law
programme.desc: Outlaws threaten to kill Micah.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: A drunk's son thinks he's heir.

programme.title: Valley of Death
programme.desc: Major Whitsett's plans to run for office in Colorado Territory prompt his colonel to send him into an Indian ambush.

programme.title: The Fourth Man
programme.desc: Bat seeks justice for a young friend murdered by three ranchers whom the young man accused of cheating at cards, but the sheriff refuses to take action against the killers.

programme.title: Return to New Orleans
programme.desc: Yancy Derringer returns to New Orleans to save his mansion from a carpetbagging Reconstruction overlord.

programme.title: Gallatin Street
programme.desc: Charged with cleaning up the notorious Gallatin Street, Yancy Derringer finds himself once again at odds with Toby Cook, owner of the Jumping Jack Casino.

programme.title: Pay Dirt
programme.desc: Claim jumpers plan a robbery.

programme.title: Billie the Great
programme.desc: Outlaws plan to rob the safe which is kept in the office of the town's barber.

programme.title: Reunion for Revenge
programme.desc: Josh protects a fugitive from escaped convicts bent on revenge. Guest stars: Ralph Meeker, James Coburn.

programme.title: Competition
programme.desc: Rival bounty hunters pursue Josh.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement.

programme.title: Seven Men From Now
programme.desc: A rancher (Randolph Scott) hunts down those responsible for killing his wife during a Wells Fargo holdup.

programme.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
programme.desc: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

programme.title: Fearful Courage
programme.desc: Hired killer forces a widow off land.

programme.title: The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Texan's service leaves him an outcast.

programme.title: The Unrelenting Sky
programme.desc: A pioneer couple refuses to move when their water supply is threatened.

programme.title: The Lariat
programme.desc: A rope trick ends in strangling.

programme.title: Death Watch
programme.desc: Indians trap men in an adobe ruin.

programme.title: Stage for Tucson
programme.desc: Robber may ride stagecoach.

programme.title: Marked Cards
programme.desc: Saloon keeper killed for cheating.

programme.title: Don Colorado
programme.desc: Hoppy is busy tending to Red, who was injured in a fall, and helping a pretty woman hold onto her copper mine.

programme.title: Black Waters
programme.desc: Oil field on Indian reservation.

programme.title: Blind Encounter
programme.desc: Blind woman's son framed.

programme.title: The Missing
programme.desc: When rancher and single mother of two Maggie Gilkeson (Cate Blanchett) sees her teenage daughter, Lilly (Evan Rachel Wood), kidnapped by Apache rebels, she reluctantly accepts the help of her estranged father, Samuel (Tommy Lee Jones), in tracking down the kidnappers. Along the way, the two must learn to reconcile the past and work together if they are going to have any hope of getting Lilly back before she is taken over the border and forced to become a prostitute.

programme.title: Second Trial
programme.desc: Matt investigates a death.

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: Matt uncovers a crime ring.

programme.title: The Golden Bride
programme.desc: A man makes a girl promises.

programme.title: Murietta
programme.desc: Mexican-American hostility stands in the way of a young girl's love.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo's Last Ride
programme.desc: Hollister must track down his pal who robs fellow poker players after losing everything.

programme.title: Outlaw's Bugle
programme.desc: Sheriff Hollister is forced to defend himself when a newspaper attempts to influence public opinion against him.

programme.title: The Baby Sitter
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find themselves caring for a 6-month-old baby.

programme.title: The Coward
programme.desc: Lucas becomes involved in a revenge fight when he befriends a young Easterner.

programme.title: The Surveyors
programme.desc: Mark runs away from home when he thinks that Lucas believes he's lying.

programme.title: Day of the Hunter
programme.desc: A hunter tries to force a fight.

programme.title: Dead Man's Claim
programme.desc: While returning to explore an old silver claim in Monument City, Nev., Bat runs afoul of two claim jumpers with itchy trigger fingers.

programme.title: The Marble Slab
programme.desc: Looking to obtain evidence to convict a gang, Pinkerton hires Bat to go undercover; posing as a marble salesman, Bat attempts to convince the gang's leader to commission a statue of himself for the town square.

programme.title: Ticket to Natchez
programme.desc: Yancy assists a U.S. Marshal in the river transport of $200,000 in Army payroll greenbacks.

programme.title: An Ace Called Spade
programme.desc: Yancy has 24 hours to save Administrator Colton from Spade Stuart.

programme.title: Johnny Tuvo
programme.desc: Bill befriends an overeager young man, Johnny Tuvo, who plans to challenge him in the upcoming horse race; however, two men at the event have more sinister plans.

programme.title: The Accuser
programme.desc: Bill is captured by a posse and accused of being one of the men who robbed a bank and shot the banker; only the sheriff, whom the banker hates for being in love with his daughter, is inclined to believe Bill.

programme.title: Call Your Shot
programme.desc: Josh must find a drunkard's son.

programme.title: Secret Ballot
programme.desc: Josh is accused of murder.

programme.title: Broken Trail
programme.desc: A veteran cowboy and his nephew save five Chinese girls from prostitution while trekking from Oregon to Wyoming.

programme.title: Broken Trail
programme.desc: A veteran cowboy and his nephew save five Chinese girls from prostitution while trekking from Oregon to Wyoming.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Rambling man Emmett (Scott Glenn) assembles a group of misfit cowboys (Kevin Costner), (Kevin Kline, Danny Glover). After helping a group of settlers track down a pack of thieves, Emmett and his men descend on the troubled town of Silverado to seek their fortunes. Soon after arriving, they discover that the town has fallen into the grasp of greedy rancher Ethan McKendrick (Ray Baker) and corrupt Sheriff Cobb (Brian Dennehy) with whom many of Emmett's men have unfinished business.

programme.title: Quiet Sunday in San Ardo
programme.desc: A man is accused of cowardice.

programme.title: Vengeance Canyon
programme.desc: An old man tempers a youth's vengeance.

programme.title: Return to Nowhere
programme.desc: An outlaw returns home to find his wife married to a marshal.

programme.title: Courage Is a Gun
programme.desc: A sheriff tries to rehabilitate a youth.

programme.title: Muletown Gold Strike
programme.desc: A boy helps an embittered rebel.

programme.title: Star Over Texas
programme.desc: A love triangle endangers a marriage.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Land-investment scam turns deadly.

programme.title: Ride, Vaquero
programme.desc: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back.

programme.title: Rough Night in Jericho
programme.desc: The only business in the Wild West town of Jericho that corrupt sheriff Alex Flood (Dean Martin) doesn't control behind the scenes is the stagecoach owned by tough-willed widow Molly Lang (Jean Simmons) and her right-hand man, Hickman (John McIntire). Former marshal Dolan (George Peppard), recently hired by Lang and Hickman as a driver, wants to stay out of the mess, but when he sees Flood's henchman Yarbrough (Slim Pickens) assault Lang, he steps up to fight the corruption.

programme.title: The Last Trophy
programme.desc: Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

programme.title: San Francisco
programme.desc: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Sheriff Hollister and his men search for Geronimo, an Apache chief, after he attacks an army supply train just north of Tombstone.

programme.title: The Return Of An Outlaw
programme.desc: After receiving a gunshot wound while running from Hollister's posse, a bank robber seeks medical attention and shelter.

programme.title: Mail-Order Groom
programme.desc: Brothers threaten a spinster's fiancé.

programme.title: A Case of Identity
programme.desc: Two tough private detectives appear in North Fork looking for a boy.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Unhappy heirs threaten a young widow.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: A boy is accused of shooting an outlaw.

programme.title: Farmer With a Badge
programme.desc: A farmer-turned-marshal rescues Bat after bandits leave him for dead; Bat helps the lawman find confidence in his new position as peacekeeper.

programme.title: The Fatal Garment
programme.desc: Wyatt Earp hires Bat as a bodyguard at his casino in El Paso; robbers distract Bat with an expensive shirt as they make off with $13,000 of Earp's money.

programme.title: A Bullet For Bridget
programme.desc: Madame Francine's cousin gets kidnapped.

programme.title: The Belle from Boston
programme.desc: The New Orleans underworld conspires to rub out administrator Colton.

programme.title: The Younger Brothers
programme.desc: The Younger Brothers, certain their past with the Quantrill Riders prevents them from living an honest life, plan a bold bank robbery that Matt and Frankie attempt to thwart.

programme.title: John Wesley Hardin
programme.desc: Two Osage Indians are murdered.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: The Hunting Party (1971)
programme.desc: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Man Of The East
programme.desc: East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Steve Harvey assumes the hosting duties for this daytime game show in which five members of one family are pitted against five members of another family. Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: Rising (Part 1 and 2)
programme.desc: A new Stargate team, lead by Dr. Elizabeth Weir embarks on a dangerous mission to a distant galaxy.

programme.title: Hide And Seek
programme.desc: McKay volunteers to be the first to try Beckett's newest ATA gene therapy device.

programme.title: Thirty Eight Minutes
programme.desc: The Stargate team must rush to save Major John Sheppard after he becomes lodged in the Stargate.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: After several attacks by the Wraiths, Dr. Elizabeth Weir contemplates if there is a spy among the team.

programme.title: Childhood's End
programme.desc: The team visit a new planet where the citizens believe ritual suicide is keeping the Wraith at bay.

programme.title: Poisoning The Well
programme.desc: Dr. Beckett strives to help the Hoffans who are working on a vaccine against the Wraith.

programme.title: Underground
programme.desc: The team visit the Genii, a peaceful farming community, with the goal of trading for food.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Upon arriving at a new planet, M5S-224, the team discovers that they can gate back to Earth.

programme.title: The Storm
programme.desc: Sheppard and Teyla discover that a massive storm is approaching the city. The team must evacuate the city.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Sheppard plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse as he attempts to regain control of Atlantis from the Genii.

programme.title: The Defiant One
programme.desc: Sheppard and McKay set out explore when they stumble upon a distress beacon coming from a Wraith ship.

programme.title: Hot Zone
programme.desc: While surveying the city for damage, scientists unknowingly release a virus causing hallucinations and death.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: The team find a paradise world, Proculus, that would make an ideal sanctuary for those fleeing from the Wraith

programme.title: Before I Sleep
programme.desc: During an exploration of the city, Sheppard and the team find an old woman in suspended animation.

programme.title: The Brotherhood
programme.desc: The team searches for a valuable Zero Point Module rumored to be hidden on the planet Dagan.

programme.title: Letters From Pegasus
programme.desc: McKay discovers a way for the team to send messages to their loved ones on Earth as the Wraith approach.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Teyla recalls a time when she and her father were captured by Wraith and subjected to disturbing experiments.

programme.title: The Siege (Part 1)
programme.desc: As Wraith hive ships approaches Atlantis, the team searches for a place to flee and a way to destroy the city

programme.title: The Siege (Part 2)
programme.desc: Just as the team is beginning to lose hope, Col. Everett is sent from the Stargate Program on Earth.

programme.title: The Siege (Part 3)
programme.desc: The team and the city are saved with the arrival of Colonel Caldwell and the Daedalus.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: Strange malfunctions begin to occur after the team returns to Atlantis from a trip to Earth.

programme.title: Runner
programme.desc: The search for Lt. Ford leads Sheppard and Teyla to planet P3M-736 where they are captured by Ronon Dex.

programme.title: Duet
programme.desc: Officer Laura Cadman's consciousness ends up in McKay's body after a glitch occurs while aboard a Wrath Dart.

programme.title: Condemned
programme.desc: The team discover a planet where criminals are placed near the Stargate to be taken by the Wraith.

programme.title: Trinity
programme.desc: The team discover the remains of an Ancient experiment to create the ultimate power generator.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Beckett begins experimenting with a new treatment that could turn the Wraiths into humans.

programme.title: Conversion
programme.desc: After being injected with the Wraith treatment, Sheppard is slowly transforming into an Iratus bug hybrid.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Sheppard and the team discover an Ancient warship called Aurora that is existing in suspended animation.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: The team are kidnapped by none other than Lt. Aiden Ford who has put together his own team of super soldiers.

programme.title: The Hive
programme.desc: The team is taken hostage by the Wraith after an attempt to destroy the Hive fails.

programme.title: Epiphany
programme.desc: The team discovers a device created by the Ancients that, without warning, pulls Sheppard in.

programme.title: Critical Mass
programme.desc: The team races to foil the Goa'uld's plans to destroy Atlantis while two Wraith ships are heading their way.

programme.title: Grace Under Pressure
programme.desc: While testing a puddle jumper, McKay and Captain Griffin lose control of the ship and crash into the ocean.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Sheppard and the team discover a world that has technology created by the Ancients.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: The team accidentally transfers the minds of two bodies in life pods floating in space into Sheppard and Weir.

programme.title: Coup d'etat
programme.desc: Col. Sheppard's team is urgently summoned to M1K-177, where Maj. Lorne's team has been attacked.

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: Lt. Kenmore wakes up in the infirmary without his memory and nightmares about being a Wraith.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: The team visits the planet Taranis, who's citizens want McKay to repair Ancient technology they've discovered.

programme.title: Allies
programme.desc: Kenmore arrives back in Atlantis with a group of Wraith, in the midst of a civil war.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: After their alliance with the Wraith backfires, the team must stop two Hive ships headed for Earth.

programme.title: Misbegotten
programme.desc: The team uses the retrovirus to turn an entire hive ship of Wraith into humans and return them to Atlantis.

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: The team comes across a small village with a revered leader who has seemingly enchanted everyone around him.

programme.title: Sateda
programme.desc: Exploring a village, the team is attacked and taken prisoner as Ronon had unknowingly lured the Wraith there.

programme.title: Progeny
programme.desc: At an abandoned Ancient testing site, the team discovers a vast metropolis supporting millions of Ancients.

programme.title: The Real World
programme.desc: Weir wakes up in Washington D.C. to discover that her entire experience in Atlantis was all in her imagination

programme.title: Common Ground
programme.desc: Summoned to a planet by a communication code, the team is ambushed by Kolya, who has his own faction of Genii.

programme.title: McKay And Mrs. Miller
programme.desc: McKay is called back to earth to convince his estranged sister, Jeannie Miller, to assist the Air Force.

programme.title: Phantoms
programme.desc: While searching for Major Leonard's missing team, McKay instead discovers a Wraith generator.

programme.title: The Return (Part 1)
programme.desc: The awakened Ancients meet with O'Neill and Woolsey, thanking them but also asking them to vacate Atlantis.

programme.title: The Return (Part 2)
programme.desc: O'Neill and Woolsey, the lone survivors of the replicators' attack, hide in an abandoned section of the city.

programme.title: Echoes
programme.desc: Teyla begins to see apparitions she believes are the ghosts of the Ancients massacred by the Replicators.

programme.title: Irresponsible
programme.desc: The team hear of a great warrior with stories of defeating both the Genii and Wraith and seek him out.

programme.title: Tao Of Rodney
programme.desc: While turning off non-essential systems, McKay is mistakenly hit by an energy beam from a mysterious device.

programme.title: The Game
programme.desc: The team realize a game they had found earlier might be more than a game.

programme.title: The Ark
programme.desc: Investigating an abandoned space station, McKay mistakenly brings one of it's scientists out of stasis.

programme.title: Sunday
programme.desc: With the entire city ordered to take a personal day the team does their best to enjoy their leisure time.

programme.title: Submersion
programme.desc: The team searches the ocean for a mobile geothermal drilling station the ancients left dormant.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: After relocating the Taranans, the Atlantis team realizes they haven't heard from the village in a long time.

programme.title: First Strike
programme.desc: The team is shocked when a satellite housing a stargate takes up orbit above Atlantis.

programme.title: Adrift
programme.desc: When Atlantis starts shutting down due to a damaged power system, McKay turns off all non-essential systems.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Lt. Col. Sheppard leads a daring raid into the Replicator city to secure a ZPM that will save Atlantis.

programme.title: Reunion
programme.desc: Ronon reconnects with a group of Satedans from his past who enlist the Atlantis team's help against the Wraith

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: Ex-bounty hunter Talion (Robert Lansing) comes home one day to find his house ablaze and his entire family slaughtered. He soon learns that the culprits are a gang led by nasty Ike Slant (Slim Pickens). While tracking the outlaws, Talion meets fellow bounty hunter Benny (Pat Wayne), who's also after Ike. Initially mistrustful of each other, Benny and Talion are forced to work together when, during a shootout with the criminals, the latter is blinded and the former injures his shooting hand.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. Expecting the worst, she brings her young daughter to safety and travels to the home of Dan Frost (Joel Edgerton), a boozing ex-lover who may be her only hope. With Dan now on her side, Jane prepares for a showdown with the vengeful John Bishop and his gang of thugs. Looking to settle an old score, Bishop must now contend with the gun-toting Jane and her new partner.

programme.desc: The show where every word counts! Hosted by Meredith Vieira, two teams of celebrities and civilians face off in a fast paced word game with a top prize of $10,000.

programme.title: The Scary List of Words
programme.desc: Jackie Tohn wants to get away from today's words!

programme.title: Colton Dunn Doesn't Believe in Ross Mathews!
programme.desc: Heidi Hamilton and Ross Mathews take on Cristela Alonzo and Colton Dunn in a rapid guessing game.

programme.title: Cheri Oteri Exposes The Show
programme.desc: Before Cheri Oteri "exposes" her team to a great round of clues, she exposes something else about life at 25 Words or Less...

programme.title: Natalie Morales and Mary McCormack vs. Chelsea Handler and Willie Garson
programme.desc: Celebrity guests Natalie Morales, Mary McCormack, Chelsea Handler and Willie Garson.

programme.title: The Fregosi Emerald
programme.desc: Grandpa warns Marilyn that the emerald ring Eddie gave her may bring bad luck.

programme.title: Zombo
programme.desc: Herman believes Eddie's affection is being stolen by a children's television idol.

programme.title: Cyrano de Munster
programme.desc: Herman pens himself into trouble when he ghostwrites love letters for a shy co-worker.

programme.title: The Musician
programme.desc: Grandpa concocts a potion to provide instant talent for Eddie when Herman forces him to take up the trumpet.

programme.title: Prehistoric Munster
programme.desc: Two of Marilyn's teachers decide to present Herman to the scientific world as the only living prehistoric man.

programme.title: A Visit From Johann
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein's great-grandson arrives with cousin Johann, who looks exactly like Herman.

programme.title: Eddie's Brother
programme.desc: Grandpa creates a playmate for Eddie.

programme.title: Herman, the Tire-Kicker
programme.desc: A used-car salesman hoodwinks Herman.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: After an argument, Herman draws a line down the center of the house and orders Grandpa to stay on his side.

programme.title: Herman's Sorority Caper
programme.desc: Herman is mistaken for a dummy by a couple of fraternity boys, who cart him off to a sorority house.

programme.title: Herman's Lawsuit
programme.desc: Herman thinks he must pay in a lawsuit.

programme.title: A Visit From the Teacher
programme.desc: Eddie's school essay about his family prompts a visit from the principal.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Policemen Slim (Bud Abbott) and Tubby (Lou Costello) go to London and meet a doctor (Boris Karloff) and his evil alter ego.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. McDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A hotel detective (Bud Abbott) and bellhop (Lou Costello) find dead bodies and a fake swami (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
programme.desc: Two guys stuck in Egypt follow a medallion to the crypt of Klaris.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

programme.title: Bride of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us
programme.desc: Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

programme.title: Curse of the Undead
programme.desc: A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Igor rescues the monster from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: Bodies Of Evidence
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Feasibility Study
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: A Special Edition
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: In The Zone
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Rite Of Passage
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Criminal Nature
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Relativity Theory
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Glyphic
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Identity Crisis
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: The Vaccine
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Fear Itself
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: The Joining
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: To Tell The Truth
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Mary 25
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Final Exam
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: The Origin Of Species
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Lithia
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He's welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Sarcophagus
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: The Balance Of Nature
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Phobos Rising
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Black Box
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: In Our Own Image
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He's emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Alien Radio
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Donor
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Small Friends
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: The Grell
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: The Human Operators
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Blank Slate
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: What Will The Neighbors Think?
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: The Shroud
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Ripper
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Tribunal
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species...and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Descent
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: The Haven
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Dj Vu
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Starcrossed
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Better Luck Next Time
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: The Gun
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it...literally.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before...and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Manifest Destiny
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: The Beholder
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Seeds Of Destruction
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming ...human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Simon Says
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Stasis
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Down To Earth
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Inner Child
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Glitch
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real...and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Decompression
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Abaddon
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: The Grid
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Supermarket Sweep
programme.desc: Teams answer questions to earn time and advantages over their competitors before going on a supermarket shopping spree; the team that adds the most valuable items to its cart wins.
