programme.title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family In Court
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: Amnesia In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: Thing Is Missing
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Crisis In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Lurch And His Harpsicord
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: Morticia, The Breadwinner
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Morticia's Favorite Charity
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Progress And The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Toupee
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: Lurch, The Teenage Idol
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Gomez, The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Portrait Of Gomez
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: Morticia's Dilemma
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: Christmas With The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: Uncle Fester, Tycoon
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: Morticia & Gomez Vs. Fester & Grandmama
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Fester Goes On A Diet
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Great Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: Ophelia Finds Romance
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: Pugsley's Allowance
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: Happy Birthday, Grandma Frump
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: Morticia, The Decorator
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Ophelia Visits Morticia
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Addams Cum Laude
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: Cat Addams
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Lurch's Little Helper
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Policy
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: Lurch's Grand Romance
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: Ophelia's Career
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: Morticia And The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: Fester's Punctured Romance
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: Gomez, The Politician
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family Tree
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: Morticia Joins The Ladies League
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: Halloween With The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: Green Eyed Gomez
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: Wednesday Leaves Home
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: Morticia, The Matchmaker
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: Lurch Learns To Dance
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: Art And The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Illness
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family Splurges
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family In Court
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: Amnesia In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: Thing Is Missing
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Crisis In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Lurch And His Harpsicord
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: Morticia, The Breadwinner
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Morticia's Favorite Charity
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Progress And The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Toupee
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: Lurch, The Teenage Idol
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Gomez, The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Portrait Of Gomez
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: Morticia's Dilemma
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: Christmas With The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: Uncle Fester, Tycoon
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: Morticia & Gomez Vs. Fester & Grandmama
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Fester Goes On A Diet
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Great Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: Ophelia Finds Romance
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: Pugsley's Allowance
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: Happy Birthday, Grandma Frump
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: Morticia, The Decorator
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Ophelia Visits Morticia
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Addams Cum Laude
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: Cat Addams
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Lurch's Little Helper
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Policy
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: Kalahari: The Flooded Desert
programme.desc: The Kalahari Desert's Okavango Delta from the point of view of crocodiles and eagles.

programme.title: Saguaro: Sentinel of the Desert
programme.desc: Undisturbed the saguaro cactus can grow to 60 feet, weigh 10 tons and live 150 years.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: Monsters of the Forest
programme.desc: The history of a giant Brazil nut tree in a Peruvian jungle; British tarantula expert; rainfall generated by the trees.

programme.title: Deep Jungle: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Expeditions to the Central African Republic, Guatemala and Cambodia to explore primates of the rain forests.

programme.title: Great Wood of Caledon
programme.desc: Emmy-winning filmmaker Hugh Miles presents a lyrical portrait of Scotland's Caledonian Forest.

programme.title: Ireland
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, the advance and retreat of ice shaped the mountains, coastlines, gorges and inland waterways of Ireland.

programme.title: Wild Way of the Vikings
programme.desc: Traveling from Norway to Newfoundland just as seafarers did in A.D. 1,000 to get a sense of how the Vikings lived in the Americas; narrator Ewan McGregor.

programme.title: In the Beginning
programme.desc: The origins of the solar system and life on Earth; how life is affected by the forces of nature. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Perpetual Motion
programme.desc: The importance of the atmosphere and the oceans both in creating and destroying life. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Heavenly Partners
programme.desc: The influence the sun and moon have on the seasons and the tides. Host: George Page. Narrator: James Earl Jones.

programme.title: Living Volcanoes
programme.desc: The varied activity, both human and natural, that occurs on the slopes of active volcanoes.

programme.title: Krakatoa: Day That Shook the World
programme.desc: The 1883 eruption of Krakatau blows open a six-and-a-half mile hole and causes tsunamis killing more than 40,000 people.

programme.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Grizzly
programme.desc: Grizzly bears cause social and environmental problems at Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Grizzly Country
programme.desc: Rangers at Denali National Park in Alaska train hikers for planned encounters with grizzlies; bears fish for salmon.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: City of Bears
programme.desc: Bear biologist Chris Morgan tracks grizzlies in the Alaskan wilderness.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: The Road North
programme.desc: Chris Morgan studies black bears caught between urban development in Anchorage, Alaska, and the wilderness.

programme.title: Bears of the Last Frontier: Arctic Wanderers
programme.desc: As winter approaches, polar bears wait to hunt on sea ice in Kaktovik, Alaska; in late spring, grizzlies await caribou on the northern slope of Alaska's Brooks Range.

programme.title: Clash: Encounters of Bears and Wolves
programme.desc: Each time the grizzly and the wolf meet in Yellowstone National Park, one of them has a tactical advantage.

programme.title: The Wolf That Changed America
programme.desc: See how a man's mission to kill a wolf had a lasting impact on wilderness preservation.

programme.title: In the Valley of the Wolves
programme.desc: The Druids are the first wolves reintroduced into Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Dogs in the Land of Lions
programme.desc: An intimate portrayal of motherhood centers on an African wild dog family in the Zimbabwean wilderness.

programme.title: Jaguar: Year of the Cat
programme.desc: Researchers and filmmakers set out to produce the first comprehensive film chronicle of the jaguar.

programme.title: Siberian Tiger Quest
programme.desc: Siberian tigers in remote Russia.

programme.title: The Story of Cats: Asia to Africa
programme.desc: How the first cats arose in Asia and eventually came to conquer Africa; an in-depth look at lions, servals, caracals, cheetahs, tigers, fishing and sand cats.

programme.title: The Story of Cats: Into the Americas
programme.desc: Cats in the Americas, including the rise of domestic cats; an in-depth look at the jaguar, urban mountain lion, ocelot, Canada lynx, margay, Siamese cat and the Sphynx.

programme.title: Cloud: Wild Stallion of the Rockies
programme.desc: The life of a wild horse in Montana proceeds from birth, through rites of passage and survival.

programme.title: Cloud: Wild Stallion of the Rockies
programme.desc: The life of a wild horse in Montana proceeds from birth, through rites of passage and survival.

programme.title: Cloud: Challenge of the Stallions
programme.desc: Cloud, the wild white stallion now in his prime, rules Arrowhead Mountain in Montana.

programme.title: America's Wild Horses
programme.desc: Cinematographer Wolfgang Bayer compares mustangs with the settling of North America.

programme.title: Origins
programme.desc: Discovering what makes humans and horses so perfect for each other And how the wild horses that were tamed 6,000 years ago became over 400 specialized breeds.

programme.title: Chasing the Wind
programme.desc: How humans saved the wild horse from extinction and how mankind created over four hundred specialized breeds over time.

programme.title: The Private Life of Deer
programme.desc: White-tailed deer in the U.S.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Magic in the Air
programme.desc: Hummingbirds, the tiniest of birds, qualify as some of the toughest and most energetic creatures in the world.

programme.title: Super Hummingbirds
programme.desc: High-speed cameras capture hummingbirds as they mate, fight and raise families.

programme.title: The Real Macaw
programme.desc: The future of the macaw, whose survival may depend on the poachers who brought them to the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Parrots in the Land of Oz
programme.desc: The colors, behaviors and habitats of the parrots occupying Australia.

programme.title: Parrot Confidential
programme.desc: Owners and rescuers discuss the pros and cons of caring for parrots; conservation efforts in the wild.

programme.title: Bonebreakers' Mountain
programme.desc: A bearded vulture, the bonebreaker, feeds atop the harsh Pyrenees separating Spain and France.

programme.title: Hunters of the Sky
programme.desc: Hugh Miles films Europe's great birds of prey and notes how man's actions endanger them and their habitats.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Snakes
programme.desc: The snake is either vilified or revered.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Turtles and Tortoises
programme.desc: The diversity and abilities of turtles.

programme.title: The Reptiles: Lizards
programme.desc: The world of lizards.

programme.title: Supersize Crocs
programme.desc: Some croc species have exceeded 20 feet -- Nile crocs, American crocs and the Asian-Pacific saltwater croc; hosted by Romulus Whitaker.

programme.title: Invasion of the Giant Pythons
programme.desc: Florida's Everglades National Park is a protected wilderness where predatory pythons thrive.

programme.title: Frogs: The Thin Green Line
programme.desc: Scientists try to save populations of frogs, as large-scale die-offs of the amphibian continue around the world.

programme.title: Bloody Suckers
programme.desc: Fleas, flies, ticks, leeches, mosquitoes, birds and bats drink blood for survival.

programme.title: Superfish
programme.desc: Marlin, sailfish, spearfish and swordfish are the largest and most highly prized of all game fish.

programme.title: Smart and Smarter
programme.desc: Animals, big or small, must remain smart to survive as they navigate without a map, build homes out of living bodies and catch prey in their unforgiving surroundings.

programme.title: The Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Takes a look at how various species in the animal kingdom utilize the art of seduction in finding a mate.

programme.title: Masters of Disguise
programme.desc: The filmmakers explore how animals disguise themselves with their skin, fur and feathers to hunt their prey and fend off their predators.

programme.title: The Power of the Velvet Paw
programme.desc: A look at the big cats of the jungle and how they embody the attributes of power, elegance and being imposing.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: With English Closed Captions. A group of Ukrainian Army fighters heads to Donetsk airport for its defense. After being shelled by artillery on the way, a team of four volunteer fighters makes it to the airport to help reinforce. The name Cyborgs, Defenders of the Donetsk Airport, is given to the Ukrainian fighters for their grit, bravery and heroics.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death
programme.desc: The story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: Rommel Routed
programme.desc: Eisenhower describes how the Allies squeezed Rommel's forces in Tunisia. The Afrika Korps attacks to the Kasserine Pass but is pushed back thanks to Patton. Allied air power helps win the day, the U.S. and British 8th Armies meet, and Tunis falls.

programme.title: TRIED BY FIRE
programme.desc: Story of the three-day attack on St. Vith and retreat of American troops when the town was lost to the Germans. Fighting by 84th infantry division in Battle of the Bulge, crossing of the Roer and Rhine, and the desperate race to the Elbe.

programme.title: Russia
programme.desc: Russian and American attitudes about war are compared. The Germans surrender to Zhukov, and Eisenhower goes to Moscow. The Berlin Blockade is mentioned, and the UN founding conference is shown.

programme.title: War and Men of God
programme.desc: 'Tell it to the Chaplain' is a favorite expression of servicemen. This is the tale of a chaplain who, every Sunday, held services amidst ear-splitting gunfire in the fox holes. But when their officer was wounded, the men didn't need a Chaplain, they needed leadership to face oncoming Germans. This Chaplain didn't let his boys down, improving leadership, not taught at O.C.S., to repel the attack.

programme.title: War Without Boundaries
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

programme.title: The Tiger Files
programme.desc: An in detail look at the Tiger Tank from drawing board to the battlefield.

programme.title: Mark Rylance
programme.desc: Actor and peace campaigner, Mark Rylance explores the extraordinary story of his grandfather, Osmond Skinner, who spent almost four years as a Japanese Prisoner of War. Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island, then was shot on Christmas day and taken as a POW.

programme.title: Last Operation
programme.desc: Operation Dewey Canyon, from January 22 through March 18, 1969, was the last major offensive by the United States Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. The 9th Marine Regiment reinforced by elements of the 3rd Marine Regiment swept through the A Shau Valley engaging in 56 days of combat mainly against the North Vietnamese Army.

programme.title: The Fall will Kill You
programme.desc: The final battle of the war begins as Russian forces advance rapidly into Berlin smashing its defenders back towards an ever-shrinking last stand. East finally meets West for the first time, when American and Russian troops shake hands at the river Elbe. US troops in Bavaria discover and enjoy the luxury trappings of Hitlers holiday home. And Adolf Hitler accepts his fate and faces the Fuhrer's...

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler the Drifter
programme.desc: Drawing upon the often overlooked memoirs of his erstwhile friend Reinhardt Hanisch and revisiting the key sites on his journey, this powerful film traces Hitler's wilderness years in Vienna and Munich. Using rare archive film and new footage of his boyhood home we follow Hitler's descent from aspiring art student to homeless drifter living in a men's shelter in Vienna.

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 1: The Killing Begins
programme.desc: Kaiser Wilhelm the 2nd of Germany had long desired to rule an empire. He thought that Germany needed a powerful Navy to protect it - especially against Britain. The Germany Navy was set to the ultimate test - war against Great Britain, putting their mighty fleet to good use. They began a naval blockade of Germany during the first days of the war and deployed their naval units.

programme.title: Onwards Ever Onwards: October-December 1944
programme.desc: Hitler's position was worsening by the day, the Nazis were still capable of inflicting terrible damage. When the Germans attempted a breakthrough in the Ardennes region of France, the Battle of the Bulge resulted in large US casualties.

programme.title: The Race for Berlin: January-March 1945
programme.desc: While the Russians moved towards Germany from the East, and the allies attacked from the west, the Japanese continued their battle in the Pacific, fighting American Marines on Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. Led by the USA, a global alliance faces overwhelming odds, launching a massive military assault to break Germany's grip on Western Europe and reclaim freedom from Nazi control.

programme.title: Normandy Invasion
programme.desc: A day by day documentary on the preparation of US troops prior to the D Day invasion and the immediate aftermath after the successful capture of the Normandy Beaches.

programme.title: James Doolittle
programme.desc: During World War II Doolittle led the famous raid on Tokyo in 1942. The famed air commander is a Medal of Honor recipient.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: 'The Vietnam War' details a conflict whose burden became unbearable and fraught with hard lessons. Learn why the most powerful nation in the world could not defeat the communist North Vietnamese. From the Gulf of Tonkin to the Tet Offensive, the war perpetually escalated.

programme.title: The Allied Blitz
programme.desc: The leaders of the world's future superpowers hold a conference in the Crimea to agree a post-war framework for Europe, and must overcome deep political division to do so. Meanwhile, in order to hasten the defeat of Germany and save millions of lives, the allies conduct an area bombing mission against a German city that will spark controversy for decades.

programme.title: The Battle for Guadalcanal
programme.desc: The first marine division captures Guadalcanal.

programme.title: A Thousand Suns
programme.desc: After years of war, the defeat of Hitler and the Third Reich is inevitable. Peace in Asia will follow peace in Europe after the detonation of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Blitzkrieg, Commando Raids, Landings, Desert War
programme.desc: The battles of the WWI were battles of attrition, opposing armies hardly moving between lines of trenches. The battles of WWII were much more dynamic: The Battle Of France, Kursk, Iwo Jima, the Siege of Tobruk and Operation Crusader.

programme.title: The Turning Point
programme.desc: It took Hitler half a war to gain an empire But it would also take him half a war to lose one Japan also wound up growing and growing only to start to fall about halfway through the war.

programme.title: Dancing on a Volcano 1929 - 1931
programme.desc: What had seemed to be an economic recovery is revealed to have been at best fragile and the world enters a global depression of unprecedented and unmeasurable savagery. Unemployment, hyperinflation and despair are everywhere and dictators arise. Old empires - Britain and France - come under pressure throughout the extended territories that they can barely afford to police.

programme.title: Episode 2: The 1960s
programme.desc: The 1966 Palomares B-52 crash occurred on 17 January 1966, when a B-52G bomber and a KC-135 tanker collided. The damage and radiation still exists to this day. In 1968 a B-52 bomber near Thule Air Base in Greenland crashed onto sea ice in North Star Bay. The explosives aboard to detonated and the nuclear payload to rupture and dispersed, resulting in radioactive contamination.

programme.title: Big Picture: Why Vietnam?
programme.desc: This film documents the buildup to the Vietnam War, from the withdrawal of French troops to the bombings of the U.S. Embassy and the intense fighting our troops engaged in to combat Ho Chi Minh and the Viet Cong. The footage features President Lyndon Johnson, Secretary of State Dean Rusk and Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara.

programme.title: Battle For The Atlantic: Greyhound vs Wolfpack - Western Approaches
programme.desc: Western Approaches is a vast area of ocean control covering thousands of square miles of the Atlantic. In these waters is set this single incident in the fiercest and longest sea battle in history. The players are not professional actors but serving officers and men of Allied Navies and Merchant Fleets. This film is dedicated to them and their comrades who made the Allied victory possible.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: 'The Vietnam War' details a conflict whose burden became unbearable and fraught with hard lessons. Learn why the most powerful nation in the world could not defeat the communist North Vietnamese. From the Gulf of Tonkin to the Tet Offensive, the war perpetually escalated.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: A Thousand Suns
programme.desc: After years of war, the defeat of Hitler and the Third Reich is inevitable. Peace in Asia will follow peace in Europe after the detonation of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Troopship Tragedy: The Sinking Of The SS Mendi
programme.desc: February 1917. To provide logistical support to WWI troops, a troopship of volunteers from the South African Native Labour Contingent is sent to France. The men never arrive. A story endures of the final hours before the volunteers drowned, when a charismatic Xhosa priest called the men to dance a warrior dance on deck as they ship sunk into the freezing water.

programme.title: The Battle of Kursk
programme.desc: After two years of war, Hitler was no closer to victory in the East, and his forces had suffered a devastating defeat at Stalingrad. Now the Germans gathered their strength for one last massive offensive to decide the outcome of the war.

programme.title: The Battle for Guadalcanal
programme.desc: The first marine division captures Guadalcanal.

programme.title: Shifting Tides in the Orient
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines the growth of independence movements in Asia in the wake of World War II. In the Dutch East Indies, Sukarno declares Indonesian independence and defeat Dutch efforts to retake their colony. In India, the British hands over control to Jawaharlal Nehru. The two new nations soon come to conflict in the region of Kashmir.

programme.title: Ready to Strike
programme.desc: Depicts the 'Tropic Lightning'' 25th Infantry Division; its history, and its exploits in Vietnam as a combat unit and a nation-building force.

programme.title: Big Picture: Civil Assistance, Korea
programme.desc: We approach this from the beginning in Korea when we had to control the civilian population...rehabilitation for tactical reasons. This is a very human, moving story and again points out our respect and concern for the individual.

programme.title: WWII - The Secret Race to the Atomic Bomb
programme.desc: In 1945, the U.S. ended WWII with atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, killing over 180,000. But the bomb's story began in Nazi Germany, prompting Roosevelt's $26B Manhattan Project to beat Hitler-and the Soviets-in a race for the A-bomb. Through archives and eyewitnesses, this film reveals the fierce arms race that shaped the fate of the world.

programme.title: Line of Fire: Stalingrad
programme.desc: This documentary traces the battle for Stalingrad, which proved to be the turning point for the Allies on the eastern front during the Second World War. Included is expert analysis by Dr Duncan Anderson and Dr Aryk Nusbacher. The bitter, bloody and inhuman struggle for Stalingrad was the turning point of the war on the eastern front and a pivotal moment of World War Two.

programme.title: Normandy Invasion
programme.desc: A day by day documentary on the preparation of US troops prior to the D Day invasion and the immediate aftermath after the successful capture of the Normandy Beaches.

programme.title: Churchill's Finest Hour: April-June 1945
programme.desc: It fell to the Russians to enter Berlin first, and as Hitler took his own life in his bunker, the war in Europe finally came to an end. Winston Churchill led the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations, but the fighting continued in the Pacific.

programme.title: Brave New World: July-September 1945
programme.desc: With Europe sifting through the rubble of a long and bitter war, the Japanese refused to surrender. A long land campaign was too high a price to pay. Truman took the decision to end WWII swiftly, with the nuclear bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: The Eyes of The World
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: Vietnam Firefight
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War, flying into jungle produces a different kind of hazard. In a daring rescue mission a desperate pilot cuts his own landing zone in forty foot tall bamboo. They come under heavy fire as they return again and again to pick up more survivors from the bamboo circle.

programme.title: Arnhem: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: In December, 1944, 400 men of the 1rst British Airborne Division paraded at Buckingham Palace to receive their grateful thanks from their king and countrymen. Although they paraded as heroes, victors they were not. They were some of the survivors of a whole airborne division of over 10,000 men lost during the most audacious and ultimately controversial battles of Operation Market Garden; Arnhem.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Republic of Korea (ROK) Soldier
programme.desc: Through the Korean Military Advisory Group, the South Korean Army has been able to build itself up to the fourth strongest Army in the world. 'The Big Picture' shows the activities of the South Korean Army and its preparations for the future.

programme.title: Lull Before the Storm: Between the Wars
programme.desc: Here's a front row seat to Japanese attack on Manchuria and the rise of Hitler and the Nazi Party. As the world was undergoing significant changes so was the military air power.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The War in Italy
programme.desc: In an initial failed attempt to become a partner the equal of Germany in the Axis Alliance, Mussolini ordered his troops towards the British positions in Egypt in September 1940. Mussolini, feeling secure in the shadow of Hitler's apparent invincibility, never dreamt that the War between Britain and Italy would culminate in his own death less than 5 years later.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, the pilots of a Soviet aviation regiment face challenges during World War II. They engage in combat, search for a downed German pilot, and receive a new recruit. The episode explores the camaraderie and determination of the pilots in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group North
programme.desc: As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany. He abandoned cooperation from western pals. By agreeing to share polish territory between the 3rd Reich and the Soviet Union after invasion, Hitler kept the Russians at bay on his eastern borders to devote attention to war with the west.

programme.title: We Strike Back
programme.desc: Pearl Harbor day has etched itself in our history. The entire nation was motivated in a fighting fury. We will see the Japanese seize Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, and the Dutch East Indies. General McArthur is profiled.

programme.title: Afrika Corps
programme.desc: This is the story of the rise and fall of one of the legendary forces of warfare. During its brief existence, the Afrika Korps forced the Allied forces ranged against it into a for war of attrition, thereby cementing its place in the annals of military history. The Afrika Korps will be forever associated with its brilliant commander Erwin Rommel, the Desert Fox of legend.

programme.title: The True Glory
programme.desc: Introduced by then General Dwight D. Eisenhower and using footage filmed by military photographers, this documentary recounts the historic events from the D-Day invasion to the end of the war. The pre-invasion preparations focus on work in munitions and heavy equipment manufacturing. The D-Day invasion, Operation Market Garden, the failed northern thrust into Holland in the fall of 1944, and more.

programme.title: Marines at Tarawa
programme.desc: The 2nd US Marines' bloody assault on Tarawa.

programme.title: Little Private
programme.desc: Nothing prepares soldiers to be surrounded by enemy tanks and infantry. When tasked with defending a recently captured town in Bastogne, Belgium, Joe's aging platoon awoke to find themselves surrounded, outnumbered and outgunned. His platoon dumbfounded; Private Joseph Richardson took matters into his own hands. Grasping a bazooka Joe sought to break up the German counterattack.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: Death and Decay
programme.desc: The story of Adolf Hitler from the days of triumph through to the final Götterdämmerung.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: The Americans are getting ready to seize Baghdad airport, in what is to be the sole battle of this war. Opposite them: the Republican Guard led by Saddam Hussein's son Qusay. programme.desc: Documentary survey of the activities of the United States Navy leading up to and during the first years of the American war in Vietnam. programme.title: A Night to Remember
programme.desc: Peggy contributes on a church project; Duck and Don try to create market appeal for a foreign beer brand; Harry recruits assistance to help with the workload in his department.

programme.title: Six Month Leave
programme.desc: Fred Rumsen gives a disappointing pitch; Pete exploits an opportunity; Don proves his loyalty; Betty finds a welcome distraction.

programme.title: The Inheritance
programme.desc: Betty visits her father; Paul's girlfriend tries to convince him to prioritize his duties; Pete's mother disapproves of his and Trudy's idea.

programme.title: The Jet Set
programme.desc: Don makes some new friends on his trip to Los Angeles; Peggy looks for romance; Duck ponders the future of Sterling Cooper.

programme.title: The Mountain King
programme.desc: Don meets up with an old friend; Pete's personal life presents problems; Joan brings her boyfriend to the office.

programme.title: Meditations in an Emergency
programme.desc: Duck offers Pete a promotion, Betty has a dangerous liaison after receiving some unwanted news, and Don returns.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Don accidentally learns a secret about Salvatore during a business trip to Baltimore; Back at the office, the firings continue, but the new management appoints Peter and Ken as new co-heads of accounts.

programme.title: Love Among the Ruins
programme.desc: Betty's father visits; Sterling Cooper handles a very specific client request; Roger makes wedding arrangements; Peggy is affected personally by a campaign.

programme.title: My Old Kentucky Home
programme.desc: The writers are forced to work after hours; Roger hosts a party; Joan and Greg host their own party; Sally has a run-in with Grandpa.

programme.title: The Arrangements
programme.desc: Don has reservations about a misguided potential client who wants to sell jai alai as the "new national pastime"; Betty's father passes away.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: Betty has hallucinations of her dead father as she delivers her baby; Peggy begins to question her future at Sterling Cooper.

programme.title: Guy Walks Into an Advertising Agency
programme.desc: The new British bosses want the staff to come in to meet their dashing new blade Guy MacKendrick; Joan tenders her resignation only to find that she has been too rash.

programme.title: Seven Twenty Three
programme.desc: As Don secures an account with Conrad Hilton, Sterling and Cooper try to strong-arm Don into signing a contract; Betty meets with her acquaintance from the governor's office.

programme.title: Souvenir
programme.desc: Don and Betty renew their love affair while on a business trip to Rome; Peter has a bout of infidelity with an au pair in his building while his wife is away.

programme.title: Wee Small Hours
programme.desc: Betty tries to meet with Henry Francis again; Don steps up his pursuit of his daughter's former teacher. Don disappoints Conrad Hilton and is forced by a client to fire Salvatore over an unwelcome advance.

programme.title: The Color Blue
programme.desc: As Sterling Cooper prepares for its 40th anniversary party, the bosses in London drop a bombshell to Lane; Miss Farrell's troubled brother pays a visit to her and Don; Betty stumbles onto her husband's secrets.

programme.title: The Gypsy and the Hobo
programme.desc: An old flame and potential client re-enters Roger Sterling's life; Joan's husband searches for a new job; and Don finally comes clean to Betty about his true identity.

programme.title: The Grown-Ups
programme.desc: Pete finds out that he lost the promotion to Cosgrove; Roger Sterling's daughter's wedding goes off as planned; Betty musters up the courage to respond to Don's confessions.

programme.title: Shut the Door. Have a Seat
programme.desc: With another sale on the horizon, Sterling, Cooper, and Draper convince Lane Pryce to fire them and then join them as they start up a new advertising firm; at home, Betty follows through with her plans to divorce Don.

programme.title: Dearly Departed
programme.desc: Forty years after a young couple is murdered, their true identities lead to a shocking twist.

programme.title: First Divorced Then Dead
programme.desc: A beloved professor is murdered.

programme.title: The One That Got Out
programme.desc: Multiple women are murdered during a Texas police hunt for a serial killer.

programme.title: Diary of a Killer
programme.desc: When a beloved mother is killed, police uncover clues in the accused killer's diary.

programme.title: All American Murder
programme.desc: When a Texas couple is murdered in their bed, authorities investigate whether the culprit is a masked intruder or someone closer to home.

programme.title: Three Shots in the Dark
programme.desc: When a pro athlete is murdered, police embark on an international chase for the killer.

programme.title: Missing From the Mall
programme.desc: When a college student vanishes from a mall parking lot, police hunt her killer.

programme.title: There Is a Monster in Me
programme.desc: When a woman is killed in small-town Texas, a secret diary reveals the killer's motive.

programme.title: The Murderer in the Minivan
programme.desc: Three women -- one missing, one murdered, one kidnapped -- and the clues leading to a killer.

programme.title: Sealed With a Kill
programme.desc: An inside look at an undercover investigation involving conspiracy, escorts and murder for hire.

programme.title: Love. Honor. Betray.
programme.desc: John Quiñones reports on the story of a young husband, father and soldier murdered while at home for the holidays; interrogation tapes and extensive police body camera footage reveal a twisted tale of heartache and greed.

programme.title: A Killer Renovation
programme.desc: A Florida mom's mysterious death leads authorities to investigate the connection to a missing engagement ring, a disastrous home renovation, and a popular TV home-makeover show.

programme.title: Killer on Campus
programme.desc: A Florida university campus is on edge when a student disappears; police say love, lies and obsession led to murder; a new witness comes forward with a claim that could potentially overturn the case.

programme.title: Into the Darkness
programme.desc: More than a decade after a teenage girl vanishes from a popular tourist destination, her killer is brought to justice; interviews with the FBI team who broke the case wide open and identified her killer.

programme.title: Highway Hunter
programme.desc: When four young women go missing, police hunt for a serial killer roaming the interstate; John Quiñones explores the families' quests for answers.

programme.title: Ruby Franke: From Momfluencer to Felon
programme.desc: Ruby Franke is a popular YouTuber known for her strict parenting; after her emaciated son escapes, begging for help, her seemingly perfect world implodes; featuring all-new body camera footage, recorded calls and a look at Ruby's private journal.

programme.title: Am I Next?
programme.desc: When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme; "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.

programme.title: How'd You Rather Die?
programme.desc: When a 16-year-old girl disappears, police have a surveillance video showing her getting into an unknown vehicle shortly after midnight; when the truth of her disappearance finally comes to light, the community is shocked by who is behind the plot.

programme.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: A beloved small-town minister is found killed in his family home and his wife and three children are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: The Hungryland Homicides
programme.desc: When a young mother goes missing, police question a pastor, the ex-husband and even a local ventriloquist.

programme.title: Forever 17
programme.desc: When two teen girls never make it home after a night out, authorities discover their dead bodies in the trunk of a car; detectives go to exhaustive lengths to identify the killer, but it takes decades before they zero in on a very unlikely suspect.

programme.title: The Unkindest Cut
programme.desc: When a beloved celebrity hairstylist is found murdered in his home, authorities consider whether it was a burglary gone wrong or something more sinister.

programme.title: A Deadly Scream
programme.desc: After the largest investigation in Tennessee's history, a key witness recants his testimony when the remains of a 20-year-old nursing student are found three years after her disappearance.

programme.title: Follow the Fingerprints
programme.desc: In the eyes of the law, a man killed his first wife, but his second wife thinks he is innocent; incredible new developments take this investigation in a completely new direction, as John Quiñones reports on the crime, the courts and the confession.

programme.title: To Have and to Hoax
programme.desc: Interview with Keith Papini after his ex-wife, Sherri Papini, served 10 months in prison for lying to federal agents about her fabricated kidnapping.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
