programme.title: Idaho Dirt Bike Tour, Oregon Overland Expo, Silver Kings Hard Enduro adventure
programme.desc: Our Ken Faught and crew head to Idaho to ride dirt bikes at the world-famous Gold Creek Lodge, then hit the Silver Kings Hard Enduro to see what this sport is all about. We top it off with a trip to the Oregon Overland Expo to check out new products.

programme.title: Kauai Overland, Costa Rica Dirt Bike & UTV Adventure, Yamaha Tenere Test
programme.desc: Our Ken Faught and Viola Bautista go overlanding on the Garden Island of Kauai. Our team also rides dirt bikes and drives UTVs in Costa Rica and tests Yamaha's impressive 700cc Tenere adventure bike.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Cornwell Tools and 20 Years of Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is not only showcasing 20 years of a how-to show, but also the tools that make it happen; he dives into the world of video games and pinball to show where they started, where they went and where they are now.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ - Stripping Paint and Restoring Panels and Parts
programme.desc: Ins and outs of stripping paint and what you might expect to see once it's done; next, Stacey walks through the steps of restoring headlight buckets.

programme.title: The Power Wagon Rules
programme.desc: Stacey digs into the unique history of how a WWII vehicle became the first mass-produced civilian 4x4 truck; he upgrades the electrical and fuel systems on a '49 Power Wagon, so you can drive it safely.

programme.title: The National Museum of Military Vehicles
programme.desc: Stacey visits the National Museum of Military Vehicles to check out the gear that shaped history and some of the veteran outreach programs that people can get involved with.

programme.title: The Great Crate Debate
programme.desc: Crate engine or old school; Stacey walks you through how to choose the right components to put together a special drivetrain that performs or looks the way you want it to; he drops one in his '59 Apache pickup!

programme.title: Power Wagon - A New Day Dawning...The Rist of the M6GT
programme.desc: The M6GT is back, but now she's a running, driving car, and a prototype of the car that is available from Retroformance; Stacey goes through the design, development and trial and error it takes to bring a new component car to the market.

programme.title: Stacey David's GearZ -- Mustang Transmission Swap
programme.desc: Stacey takes an old, beat-up '66 Mustang and puts some pep back in its step; he shows you how to replace an old automatic transmission with a quick-shifting Tremec T5 5-speed and how to lift an old cab or body off a frame without destroying it.

programme.title: Show Truck With a Diesel Twist and Capping a Gladiator
programme.desc: Stacey looks at a new twist on tool storage and sets up a Jeep Gladiator for your outdoor adventure needs!

programme.title: The Stunt Double Final Reveal
programme.desc: The Stunt Double is back in the shop for its reveal and payoff; inspired by the FALL GUY truck, the Stunt Double is a ground up, frame off build of a square body Chevy truck that pays tribute to the stunt world.

programme.title: The Mod Rod, Stripping and Prepping a Cab
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in one of the show cars of the 1970s, the Mod Rod; after that, he shows how to properly disassemble the cab or body of your project and pre-fit some new components at the same time.

programme.title: The Datsun 240Z -- A Sports Car for the Masses
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a 1970s Datsun 240Z; he digs into the history of these cars and shows some of the ways to deal with the fragile parts and panels.

programme.title: Digging Into the Datsun 240Z Engine and Drivetrain
programme.desc: The 240Z project is back in the shop as Stacey digs into the magic of the original straight-six engine and drivetrain; he introduces you to the vintage Little Debbie's delivery truck with a sound system.

programme.title: Utah 4x4 Adventure, Inside Far Out Camping Co., Honda Transalp Test
programme.desc: We head to Utah to go off-grid with an X-Games gold medalist who is also an amputee. We also test Far Out Camping Co.'s unique rig in Oregon and tell you all about Honda's Transalp adventure bike.

programme.title: Arizona Off-Road Adventure, Baja UTV test, Sun Lite 14 THX Trailer feature
programme.desc: We head to Baja to test a race UTV, then head to Arizona for another incredible off-road adventure. Our crew also tests Sun Lite's 14 THX toy hauler trailer. This is a cool concept that offers so much versatility.

programme.title: Off-Road Travel TV - Jeep Project, Custom Van Build, Bali Off-Road Adventure
programme.desc: Our crew builds two project vehicles including a Jeep Wrangler and Mercedes Sprinter Vans. These are loaded with high-tech gadgets. We also head to Bali for unique off-road adventure and the sights will leave you breathless.

programme.title: Moses-Man of God
programme.desc: Two of the world's great religions, Christianity and Judaism, base many of their most important beliefs on declarations made to Moses atop Mt. Sinai. Are the miraculous stories attributed to Moses factual? Did Moses receive the Ten Commandments from God?

programme.title: Biblical End Times
programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Biblical Old Testament Mysteries
programme.desc: Did the legendary cities of sin Sodom and Gomorrah really exist? Were they destroyed by fire and brimstone? Did looking at the destruction turn people into pillars of salt? Archaeological discoveries include the findings of bodies encased in salt may answer these questions. Has the Tower of Babel been found? Have the modern sciences of linguistics, sociology and archaeology given us the answer?

programme.title: Biblical Armageddon
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: Biblical Adam and Eve
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. What are archaeologists, paleontologists, biologists and theologians saying today? Is the story fact or fiction? The evidence may shock you. Where was the Garden of Eden? What was it like? Does it still exist, if indeed it ever did? Explore the evidence and journey back to the original birthplace of man.

programme.title: Lost Biblical Treasures
programme.desc: The legendary Holy Grail, believed to be a relic of the Last Supper of Christ, has eluded searchers for 2,000 years and the quest continues today. Or has it actually been found as some claim and are its legendary powers real? Will scientists ever decipher the Copper Scroll found near the Dead Sea and learn the way to a 2,000 year old treasure?

programme.title: Biblical Prophecies
programme.desc: Approximately 2,500 prophecies appear in the Bible and 2,000 have been fulfilled. Did biblical prophets have special abilities that allowed them to foretell the future? Has modern technology actually created the devices for these ancient predictions of impending disasters to come true? Explore the predictions of the prophets, then decide for yourself: Are ancient prophecies today's reality?

programme.title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: John
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: James and Jude
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: Judas
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: Shroud of Turin: Fraud or Evidence of Christ's Resurrection?
programme.desc: Is it the cloth that covered Jesus in the tomb? A silent witness to the greatest event in history? What are its secrets? New evidence reveals the truth.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.

What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: The Life of Joseph Part 1
programme.desc: Joseph interprets a dream for Pharaoh and is then put in charge of the whole of Egypt.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle: What is the Real Story of Christmas?
programme.desc: For 2,000 years the birth of Jesus has been celebrated. Can the New Testament solve the mysteries of Christmas? New evidence provides a surprising look at the first Christmas.

programme.title: Jerusalem: Where it all Begins
programme.desc: Our road trip Bible study truly begins with one Man, Jesus Christ, and in one city, Jerusalem.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: Early Years of Jesus
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler
programme.desc: The thrilling Biblical story of Joseph is told in this high quality 3-D animated feature film for children ages 5 and up.

programme.title: The Savior
programme.desc: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

programme.title: Jesus' Birth: Is the Miracle to Christmas True?
programme.desc: Two thousand years ago Jesus Christ was born. Did He really exist? Experience the joy and wonder of those who witnessed the Christmas miracle - the birth of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Apparition of Mary: Was There a Miracle at Fatima?
programme.desc: In 1917, two little girls and one small boy claimed to see and hear the Virgin Mary near Fatima, Portugal. What did the Fatima children witness? Learn the surprising answers.

programme.title: James, Jesus' Brother
programme.desc: In the first years, why did James, referred to as the 'brother of the Lord,' appear to be the veritable successor to Jesus? Did Jesus have brothers? Why do some of the Gospels proclaim the virginity of Mary, Jesus' mother? Why did his family believe that Jesus was 'crazy?' Were his mother and his brother opposed to the group of twelve disciples?

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder

programme.title: The Other Cheek

programme.title: The Candy Striper

programme.title: Fat, Fat, the Water Rat
programme.desc: Buffy goes to dance class but finds her teacher is not there. While waiting to be picked up, she meets some kids playing a game and joins them.

programme.title: The Toy Box
programme.desc: Bill falls over one of the twin's toys, and realizes they constantly have toys out which makes the place messy. Bill tells the twins that any toy left out will be taken away from them.

programme.title: Take Me out of the Ballgame
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy try out for the stick-ball team that plays on their street. Only one of the twins has skill and is accepted on the team.

programme.title: You Like Buffy Better
programme.desc: The twins compete for Uncle Bill's undivided attention. Each seems to think he likes the other twin better.

programme.title: Freddie
programme.desc: Bill wants to take Freddie out to dinner, but also has to go to the twins open house at school. Bill takes Freddie to the school, and she just loves it. She starts to think she wants to have kids.

programme.title: Our Friend Stanley

programme.title: Somebody Upstairs

programme.title: Star Dust

programme.title: Best of Breed

programme.title: A Man's Place

programme.title: Now Turn North
programme.desc: God didn't intend for you to live in this struggle; He meant for you to pass through it. This sermon will encourage you to head in the direction of your future and not turn back.

programme.title: Your Next Messy Step
programme.desc: This message is for when life feels uncertain, and you're not sure what God wants you to do next. We often look for strategy or certainty, but God's looking for surrender. Pastor Steven teaches from the life of Jacob how to take the next messy step.

programme.title: It's Not Fair
programme.desc: Are you disappointed because of what happened or because of what you expected would happen? When life feels unfair, it's easy to compare your story to someone else's and wonder why things worked out differently; peace comes when you stop.

programme.title: A Steady Hand For A Sudden Blessing
programme.desc: In A Steady Hand For A Sudden Blessing, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that even when we don't see God moving, His hand still holds us steadily.

programme.title: This Is Then
programme.desc: Some things look stupid to the world… until God uses them to change everything. If you've been holding back because you need everything to make sense, this will call you to trust what God promised and practice gratitude in the hard place.

programme.title: The Prison of Offense
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how to escape offense by treating it as a decision, not an identity.

programme.title: When God Gets Ready
programme.desc: People label, but God names. You don't have to chase identity or earn worth, because you've always been called, loved, and set apart for something more.

programme.title: Not Here
programme.desc: Do you ever feel like your prayers are going unanswered? The enemy wants you to believe God's not listening, but the truth is He hears you. His presence is with you in the mountains and the valleys, and He's working one moment at a time.

programme.title: SO BE IT [Full Album]
programme.desc: The official live video for SO BE IT by Elevation Worship featuring Tiffany Hudson & Chris Brown.

programme.title: God's Up To Something Upstream
programme.desc: In God's Up To Something Upstream!, Pastor Steven reminds us that wherever we have a problem, God already has a plan.

programme.title: Found Fishing
programme.desc: In Found Fishing, we're reminded that Jesus is waiting to meet us right where we're at - all we have to do is come to Him.

programme.title: Hold On To Your Song
programme.desc: Jonathan Josephs shows how worship helps you remember God's faithfulness through hardship.

programme.title: When Jesus Is Your Jury
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals freedom from human opinion and performance through Jesus' verdict.

programme.title: What Are You Doing
programme.desc: Ever find yourself asking God, What are You doing?Some seasons only make sense after you've gone through them. If you're dealing with confusion, frustration,or unmet expectations, remember:God's still working, even when you can't see what He's doing.

programme.title: Don't Waste Your Angel
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how walking in God's promises brings protection, position, and preparation.

programme.title: This Time Around...
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how persistence and obedience help you take the next step in faith.

programme.title: When You Just Can't Win
programme.desc: If you're feeling stuck in a cycle of defeat, remember that God's promises are guaranteed but not automatic. Keep consistently showing up and praising Him for the victories He's given you, because more are on the way.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: The God Of A Way
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that God always provides a way through the season you face.

programme.title: Make Peace With Your Strength
programme.desc: In Make Peace With Your Strength, Pastor Steven Furtick explains that the strength we have now will become the strength needed for what's next.

programme.title: The God Of After
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how opposition can point to the purpose God placed on your life.

programme.title: Your Label Is Lying
programme.desc: This sermon is for someone who has been hearing the same lies from the enemy for so long that you've started to believe them. But you are not your issue. You are not your bad decision. It's time to interrupt your story with truth and leave the lies behind, because the Word says otherwise.

programme.title: I Thought It Was Through
programme.desc: When despair sets in, it's easy to assume it'll always be this way. But what if a shift in thinking could break that cycle? Your thoughts have the power to disrupt your despair, especially when you stop focusing on what happened and start trusting the God who never left you.

programme.title: Take Your Notes On The Boat!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shares how remembering God's Word builds trust before answers come.

programme.title: God Prompts
programme.desc: We often ask God to do what we want, but faith starts with doing what He says. When you trust God as your good Father and follow His prompting, even small steps can unlock something big.

programme.title: Hand Him The Plan
programme.desc: Sometimes the battle in your mind is proof that God's trying to do something great in your heart. What you see isn't the full picture of what God has for you. When you hand God your plans, you make room for His purpose.

programme.title: My Joy Is My Job
programme.desc: Don't let your process become your prison. In My Joy Is My Job, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that just because we feel the pressure of our situation doesn't mean that God's not in it with us.

programme.title: Christ Is In Me. I Am Enough.
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick and Pastor Holly Furtick show how identity in Christ breaks self-doubt.

programme.title: God's Got You
programme.desc: Pastor Holly Furtick shares how grace and mercy bring rest from stress, guilt, and performance.

programme.title: Where Breakthrough Begins
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explores what can delay or block the breakthrough you are praying for.

programme.title: Take Your Notes On The Boat!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shares how remembering God's Word builds trust before answers come.

programme.title: Move It To The Middle
programme.desc: Stressed, insecure, and stuck - that's how Moses felt, too. But that wasn't the end of his story, and it's not yours, either. It's just the middle. There's hope past this chapter, and it's found by shifting your focus back to God.

programme.title: I'm Confused About My Calling
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how to discern God's calling and move faithfully without a clear answer.

programme.title: Let's Build Something
programme.desc: Jesus saves you and makes you new, but He doesn't stop there. Next, He'll give you something to do. Pastor Earl McClellan shares from Nehemiah to show that God has called you to build something, but the timing might not be what you expect.

programme.title: God Gave It To Me
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how focusing on God sustains you through weariness and into victory.

programme.title: Stop Staring At That Stone
programme.desc: Have you ever noticed how two people can be looking at the same thing and have completely different perspectives on it? One might see a problem while the other sees a reason to praise. There might be something in your life that looks like a problem right now, but God is inviting you to pivot so you can see the truth.

programme.title: Page Turner
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how life's mess can begin a new story for God's glory.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: Don't Let The Funeral Fool You
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how releasing dead expectations to God renews growth and vision.

programme.title: Filled By Faith!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how to move forward in faith through grief, fear, and uncertainty.

programme.title: You're Worth It
programme.desc: It's easy to feel like you're only as good as your last performance or your biggest mistake. But God doesn't evaluate you the way the world does. Your value was settled before you even got started.

programme.title: Expecting Change
programme.desc: God doesn't just want to fix you, He wants to restore you. Right now, He's transforming you to impact others. Expect more than a personal breakthrough; expect God to exceed your expectations and bless others through your life.

programme.title: Cover The Spread
programme.desc: When the odds are against you, face the battle anyway. In Cover The Spread, Pastor Steven Furtick challenges us to turn our problems into petitions - because God's got the answer.

programme.title: Learning Hope the Hard Way
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God uses hardship to give birth to greater hope.

programme.title: You Can Skip This!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to move beyond fear and doubt by taking the next step God asks of you.

programme.title: 3 Habits of a Healthy Heart
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals three habits for improving attitude, enduring hardship and sustaining hope.

programme.title: Tune Your Heart To Truth
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how God's truth protects your heart from the enemy's distractions.

programme.title: I'm Going Through But I'm Running Over
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God makes a way through adversity when you refuse to lose heart.

programme.title: Not Something, But Someone
programme.desc: Pastor Steven shares a simple truth that can help you endure life's hardest trials. True security isn't the absence of trouble; it's the presence of a Savior who promises you'll never walk through it alone.

programme.title: When Waiting Isn't Working
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows when faith requires action instead of more waiting for a perfect next step.

programme.title: The God Of Already
programme.desc: God already sees you for who you truly are. In The God of Already, Pastor Steven teaches us that God's plan for our lives is closer than we realize.

programme.title: Fix Your Focus
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how right focus honors God and strengthens the relationships you love.

programme.title: The God Of Also
programme.desc: Don't limit your potential. In The God of Also, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that understanding the calling God has placed on our lives also requires us to let go of the limited idea of who we believe He's created us to be.

programme.title: It's Hard To Hear God
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explains how to recognize, trust and obey God's voice amid noise and uncertainty.

programme.title: Breaking The Bondage Of Wrong Belief
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how believing God is enough breaks captivity to lesser things.

programme.title: The Lord Will Lighten Your Load
programme.desc: When you've been hurt, it can be hard to keep hoping. But God wants to lift the weight you've been carrying today. Learn from the life of Israel (Jacob), how God will give you a strategy to unburden your heart and move forward.

programme.title: Dinner with Ozzy
programme.desc: Ozzy talks to Kelly and Melinda about being put in jail for stealing.

programme.title: What Goes Up
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon visit the White House; Kelly performs at the MTV Movie Awards; Jack pines for Natalie Portman.

programme.title: Must Come Down
programme.desc: Disaster strikes as Sharon is diagnosed with colon cancer and Jack breaks his arm jumping off a Malibu pier.

programme.title: The Ozz Man and the Sea
programme.desc: Kelly takes off for her European singing tour; Jack makes his acting debut on "Dawson's Creek"; Ozzy tries to build a beach fire for Sharon and makes a comical attempt at deep-sea fishing.

programme.title: Beauty and The Bert
programme.desc: Kelly reluctantly brings home her first boyfriend, evoking motherly concern from Sharon, who tries to nip the romance in the bud.

programme.title: Smells Like Teen Spirits
programme.desc: Sharon makes amends with her father after not speaking with him for over twenty years.

programme.title: Meow Means No
programme.desc: Kelly recruits her friend Sarah to play the drums in her band.

programme.title: It's A Hard Knock LIfe
programme.desc: Kelly grows frustrated with all the appearances she must make as a recording artist.

programme.title: Cleanliness is Next to Ozzyness
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly tired of the dogs and their tendency to defecate in the house.

programme.title: Viva Ozz-Vegas
programme.desc: The Osbournes pack their bags for Sin City as Ozzy prepares for a concert and Kelly celebrates her birthday.

programme.title: My Big Fat Jewish Wedding
programme.desc: Sharon and Ozzy decide to renew their wedding vows at a hotel on New Year's Eve.

programme.title: What A Boy Wants
programme.desc: The Osbournes struggle to come up with a gift for Jack's birthday.

programme.title: Fleas A Crowd
programme.desc: The pets suffer from a flea infestation, creating havoc around the house and leaving everyone miserable.

programme.title: Run Ozzy Run
programme.desc: Ozzy continues to work out with his trainer, Pete, who Ozzy jokes may be a robot.

programme.title: Fists of Fury
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon prepare to leave for a few days on a Hawaiian vacation.

programme.title: Mama, I'm Staying Home
programme.desc: Ozzy decides to stay home while Sharon, Melinda and the kids travel to New York.

programme.title: Tennis Racket
programme.desc: Sharon receives a peace offering from one of her folk-singing neighbours.

programme.title: A Little Ditty About Jack and Brieann
programme.desc: Jack becomes interested in Courtney Love's houseguest; Ozzy writes a new song.

programme.title: Angler Management
programme.desc: After 17 years of waiting, Ozzy fulfills his dream of taking Jack on a fishing trip.

programme.title: Bye Bye Babies
programme.desc: Jack and Robert fly to England to spend time at the Osbournes' other home.

programme.title: Ozz That Ends Well
programme.desc: Kelly has problems with Bert; Jack deals with violent sleep habits.

programme.title: Catching Up with the Osbournes
programme.desc: Season 2 starts off with a recap of the first season.

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: The family hold a Christmas party in their home, with guests such Eva Mendes and Brendan Fraser.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Ozz
programme.desc: Sharon faces pressure from the powers that be at her talk show.

programme.title: Car Jacked
programme.desc: Jack turns 18 and receives a car as a birthday present.

programme.title: Rebel Without An Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon fret about all of the time they must spend apart as she works on her talk show.

programme.title: Return of the Ring
programme.desc: Ozzy loses a diamond pinkie ring that is worth over $100,000.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: Ozzy has a horrible ATV accident while on a promotional tour with Kelly.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: After three weeks in the hospital, Ozzy is released and continues to convalesce at his home in England.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman
programme.desc: Kelly annoys everyone, particularly Sharon, with her disgusting lack of personal hygiene.

programme.title: Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: Ozzy Knows Best
programme.desc: Ozzy is upset by Kelly's tendency to wear revealing outfits when she goes out to clubs and parties.

programme.title: Valentine Daze
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Ozzy begins suffering from insomnia. He eventually undergoes testing with a sleep disorder expert to determine the cause. Jack gets a tattoo of a cross on his chest, but Ozzy and Sharon do not like it.

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Off
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: A Farewell to Ozz
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.

programme.title: Bark At The Moon
programme.desc: The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.

programme.title: Like Father Like Daughter
programme.desc: Ozzy releases his first solo album in six years.

programme.title: Won't You Be My Neighbour
programme.desc: Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.

programme.title: Tour of Duty
programme.desc: Ozzy is working out with a personal trainer in preparation for an upcoming tour.

programme.title: Break A Leg
programme.desc: Ozzy is touring while Sharon returns home, planning to reunite with Ozzy in Houston because she misses him.

programme.title: Get Stuffed
programme.desc: Ozzy mixes alcohol with the pain medication for his foot injury and winds up stoned.

programme.title: No Vagrancy
programme.desc: Jack invites his friend Jason Dill, a professional skateboarder, to stay at the house.

programme.desc: Sharon tells Ozzy and Jack that one of their tour truck drivers had an accident the other day.

programme.desc: The team goes electric and test Audi's first electric model, the eTron SUV, versus the Tesla Model X.

programme.title: Season 28 Episode 10

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 1

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 3

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Vicki tests Ford's Focus ST170 and concludes that it's a good car but no rival for the Honda's Civic Type-R.

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 5

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Tiff tests the new MGTF. Quentin Willson reveals some ways people try to get off their speeding tickets.

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Adrian tests Vauxhall's new Vectra, he finds it dull but it's better than the model it replaces.

programme.title: Season 1 Episode 8

programme.desc: The team visit the Paris motor show and look at many of the new models revealed there.

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 2

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: The team visit the British International Motorshow and see cars they didn't see at the recent Paris show.

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Tiff tests a comprehensive selection of the latest hot hatches including the long-awaited Ford Focus RS.

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 6

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 7
programme.desc: Multi-millionaire John Caudwell visits Fifth Gear for some advice on what motors to choose.

programme.title: Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Tom tests Nissan's new Micra. Adrian goes in search of haunted cars and is skeptical they can exist at all.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 1
programme.desc: Quentin and Tiff hold a head-on collision, piloting two remote controlled cars into each other at 60 mph.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 2

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: We assume that driving in a big SUV means we're safe, but do you know what it takes for one to topple over?

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Tiff and Adrian stage their own car chase and watch experts who worked on James Bond do the special effects.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 5
programme.desc: Tiff and Adrian go to the secret lab of the world's leading car armourer and race an armoured Range Rover.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 6
programme.desc: Quentin enlists the help of a car psychologist for someone who can't drive without swearing at other drivers.

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 7
programme.desc: Which open-topped two seater offers the most fun - will it be a TVR, Lotus, or Porsche?

programme.title: Season 3 Episode 8
programme.desc: Fifth Gear sees if there is any truth in the old cliches - who are the better drivers, men or women?

programme.title: Season 4 Episode 1
programme.desc: Vicki and Tiff look at the car accident that's ten times more likely to cause you an injury; a rear impact.

programme.title: Season 4 Episode 2

programme.title: Season 4 Episode 3

programme.title: Season 4 Episode 8
programme.desc: In an astonishing series of experiments Tiff and Vicki find out just how dangerous ordinary items can be.

programme.title: Season 5 Episode 3

programme.title: Season 5 Episode 6

programme.title: Season 5 Episode 8
programme.desc: Adrian will be asking what makes a celebrity car valuable and meeting people who buy and collect them.

programme.title: Season 6 Episode 3
programme.desc: Fifth Gear will be testing three of the most economical cars on the market.

programme.title: Season 6 Episode 5

programme.title: Season 6 Episode 8

programme.title: Songs For the Dead
programme.desc: Kesha and Betty Who unravel the dark mysteries of a historic opera house.

programme.title: A Terrifying Truth
programme.desc: Kesha and GaTa show up for a night of terror at the Westerfeld House, trying to figure out whether illusionist Harry Houdini is responsible for the paranormal activity there or if it's something else.

programme.title: Into Bigfoot's Lair
programme.desc: Kesha and Jojo Fletcher enter a supernatural vortex in search of Bigfoot.

programme.title: Kesha Faces Mortality
programme.desc: Kesha and Karen Elson peel back the curtain on an infamous secret society.

programme.title: Descent Into Madness
programme.desc: Kesha and Big Freedia face their fears at Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum.

programme.title: The Osbournes: Night of Terror
programme.desc: Steve and Amy travel to Waterford, Conn., to investigate a recently separated woman's claims that her family is under attack by a paranormal entity; Amy discovers that the key to what's haunting the living may not necessarily reside with the dead.

programme.title: Phantoms of the Fire
programme.desc: The team reopens Hans Holzer's 50-year-old case documenting rampant paranormal activity at one of the oldest houses in Rye, N.Y., to find out if its tortured souls have finally moved on or simply moved.

programme.title: They Buried Me Alive
programme.desc: The team resurrects ghost hunter Hans Holzer's case file on the haunted Morris-Jumel Mansion in New York City to investigate a dark, mysterious presence residing within the historic home.

programme.title: A Grave Revenge
programme.desc: The team investigates San Diego's infamous Whaley House, deemed by Hans Holzer as the most haunted house in the United States, to discover if the home's ghostly occupants are pursuing a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: The Devil in Texas
programme.desc: The team resurrects one of Hans Holzer's most tragic cases; the team members investigate unexplained activity terrorizing a family, and it is disturbingly similar to poltergeist activity witnessed by Holzer 50 years ago in Tyler, Texas.

programme.title: Phantom Crew
programme.desc: The team reopens Hans Holzer's investigation into a Revolutionary War-era warship in Baltimore Harbor; they discover the spirits of the ship's deep, dark past may still be manning their positions on a postmortem mission.

programme.title: Haunting of Lambert Castle
programme.desc: The team resurrects Hans Holzer's investigation of a mysterious castle in Paterson, N.J.; their exploration of the lavish mansion reveals a woman's recurring nightmares may have a supernatural source in the dwelling's dark history.

programme.title: Legends and Lies
programme.desc: The team members revive Hans Holzer's investigation of the Ocean-Born Mary House in Henniker, N.H.; they traverse multiple states and wade into the dark waters of New England folklore in search of the elusive truth behind the mysterious haunting.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: As the team reinvestigates the Howard-Dickinson House in Henderson, Texas, a case that eluded Hans Holzer his whole life, the investigation reveals that local lore about the historic home may contain a dark family secret.

programme.title: Possessor's Curse
programme.desc: When the team reopens Hans Holzer's case file into the Ayers-Allen House in Metuchen, N.J., where he documented entities dating back to colonial times, they discover the spirits there may have a more ominous origin.

programme.title: Bloodline
programme.desc: The team reopens Hans Holzer's unsettling investigation of the infamous Barnstable House in Cape Cod, Mass.; they discover the tragic spirits from the property's past may still be seeking a horrific reckoning with the living.

programme.title: Decrypted
programme.desc: The team looks back at their scariest, most insane and outrageous moments; they answer viewer-submitted questions, reveal insider information, share insights, and even offer up some never-before-seen footage and evidence.

programme.title: Phantom Hand
programme.desc: In 1963, a terrified Cleveland family calls in ghost hunter Hans Holzer after witnessing a phantom hand pry up nails and open a trap door; the team heads to Ohio, where disturbing clues lead them to the surprising source of the ghastly haunting.

programme.title: Tell Me No Lies
programme.desc: Hans Holzer believed a sensational tale of heartache and murder hid the real story behind one of his most famous cases; the team heads to New York City's Old Merchant's House to uncover the terrifying truth of this Victorian-age haunting.

programme.title: Death to Tyrants
programme.desc: Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and Shane Pittman reopen the terrifying case of the Surratt Tavern in Clinton, Md., the infamous first stop of John Wilkes Booth after assassinating Abraham Lincoln in 1865.

programme.title: Final Word
programme.desc: Dave Schrader, Cindy Kaza and Shane Pittman return to Ohio's Franklin Castle, witnessing the troubled spirit manifest before their eyes; their biggest discovery is something Holzer himself missed.

programme.title: Edge of the Veil
programme.desc: Hans Holzer had a lifelong obsession with Rockland County, N.Y., the site of his first case; half a century later, the team attempts to decode the region's rampant paranormal activity.

programme.title: Blood In the Water
programme.desc: Hans Holzer heard stories of paranormal activity taking place on Staten Island's historic Conference House, a site famous for peace but with a dark and bloody past; when the team returns, the spirits guide them to the water's edge.

programme.title: Welcome to America's Most Haunted Town
programme.desc: The paranormal team takes on their first case, investigating a report about a civil war soldier haunting an employee at the local bakery and unearthing a shocking secret.

programme.title: Do You Know You're Dead
programme.desc: The team investigates a student's run-in with a ghost in her dorm room.

programme.title: She Didn't Have a Face
programme.desc: After the sighting of a headless woman at one of the oldest homes in Shepherdstown, the experts investigate.

programme.title: Grave Stalker
programme.desc: The team rushes to help a woman who heard a phantom gunshot in the center of town and fears that an angry spirit stalks her.

programme.title: It's Behind You
programme.desc: The team investigates reports of a phantom corpse floating in a river.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Nick Groff investigates a house emitting mysterious baby cries and the team suspect they've stumbled upon the origin of the dark presence responsible.

programme.title: Return to Shepherdstown
programme.desc: The unusual activity subsided after wrapping the investigation, but when Chief King checks in with locals he hears about a disturbing uptick of hauntings nearby and fears Shepherdstown is one small piece of a bigger puzzle.

programme.title: They're Back

Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Blue Hill Avenue
programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Christmas in Carolina
programme.desc: Career-driven investment banker Elle has given up on love until she meets Wesley, who invites her to his hometown in South Carolina, where she rediscovers the spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
programme.desc: Framed for a homicide by his fellow officers, a detective (Dean Ambrose) tries to expose the conspiracy to clear his good name.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

programme.title: Caught in the Crossfire
programme.desc: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: Traffik
programme.desc: Brea and John embark on a romantic weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They are pleasantly surprised when two of their friends, Darren and Malia, also show up unexpectedly. Their plans for fun soon give way to terror when members of a violent biker gang invade the peaceful countryside. Banded together, they now find themselves in a fight for their lives as their assailants will stop at nothing to protect their secrets from the outside world.

programme.title: April Fools
programme.desc: A cruel prank on April Fool's Day has deadly consequences for a group of Chicago teenagers.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: Blue Hill Avenue
programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Soldier Boyz
programme.desc: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves.

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.

programme.title: We the Party
programme.desc: A smart but underachieving teen (Mandela Van Peebles) sets his sights on a brainy classmate (Simone Battle) who is driven to succeed.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when bickering siblings in a newly blended household magically switch bodies.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: A Converted Boathouse Becomes a Beautiful Home on Nantucket
programme.desc: Step inside designer Gary McBournie and Bill Richards's Nantucket oceanside escape; see the boat shed transformed into a breezy summer sanctuary perfect for entertaining; every corner is infused with a sophisticated yet delightful nautical flair.

programme.title: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Darius Rucker brings together an all-star team to transform a historic mansion.

programme.title: Sweet Tea & Southern Hospitality
programme.desc: Hospitality takes center stage when a Victorian ballroom gets a modern makeover.

programme.title: Dinnertime Down South
programme.desc: Family traditions shine bright as the dining room gets its moment in the spotlight.

programme.title: The Thanksgiving Table & More
programme.desc: Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

programme.title: Artful & Eclectic Designer Dwelling
programme.desc: Andrea Schumacher shows her Colorado home which captures the essence of her adventures.

programme.title: Prismatic & Patterned LA Bungalow
programme.desc: Looking inside Los Angeles-based designer Dani Dazey's pink bungalow in Highland Park, Calif.

programme.title: The Reveal
programme.desc: This is the moment every designer loves and no client ever forgets; it's the moment when a home is complete, the design work is finished, and the transformation is ready to be unveiled.

programme.title: Coloring Outside the Classic Cottage
programme.desc: Just outside of Charleston, Mary Welch Fox brings her signature edge to what looks like a classic cottage-until the front door swings open; inside, it's anything but expected: color-drenched walls, bold wallpaper, and fearless style at every turn.

programme.title: It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
programme.desc: Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

programme.title: Desert Beginnings
programme.desc: DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

programme.title: Concrete Chaos & Joshua Tree Charm
programme.desc: Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

programme.title: Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
programme.desc: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

programme.title: Living With Leo
programme.desc: Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

programme.title: Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
programme.desc: Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

programme.title: Rustic Meets Refined
programme.desc: Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

programme.title: The Thanksgiving Table & More
programme.desc: Easy how-tos for hosting a memorable gathering.

programme.title: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
programme.desc: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

programme.title: The Reclaimed Kitchen
programme.desc: Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

programme.title: Designed to Dine
programme.desc: Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

programme.title: The Backyard Blueprint

programme.title: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!

programme.title: BEC for One, For Many
programme.desc: Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.

programme.title: Half Homemade Matzo Ball Soup
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.

programme.title: Peperonata Pasta
programme.desc: Elevated pasta doesn't need to be complicated or expensive. Chef Frankie Celenza makes Peperonata Pasta with just 5 ingredients. Plus, how to properly store sauce for a future meal.

programme.title: Frozen Broccoli, Bechamel, Mac, and Cheese
programme.desc: Fancy meets frozen with this easy meal the whole family will love. Chef Frankie Celenza makes Broccoli Mac & Cheese with a roux-based béchamel and frozen broccoli. Plus, a tip before you throw away that Parmesan cheese rind.

programme.title: Bahn Mi oh My
programme.desc: When life gives you lemons, make herb mayo. That's exactly what Chef Frankie Celenza creates as the perfect condiment to top this flavor-packed, easy-to-make-at-home Bahn Mi sandwich.

programme.title: Pub-Style Pie
programme.desc: A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.

programme.title: Pantry Pasta E Fagioli
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza whips up cozy Pasta e Fagioli from pantry staples, turning simple beans and pasta into a soup or stew that tastes like Nonna made it. This recipe is the ultimate way to clean out your fridge and pantry.

programme.title: Can you say, Cassoulet!
programme.desc: Chef Frankie serves up a struggle take on the French cassoulet home with easy leftover ingredients.

programme.title: Meatloaf More Than Once
programme.desc: Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.

programme.title: Soba So Good
programme.desc: What's better than hot noodles on a hot day? Cold noodles on a hot day! Chef Frankie Celenza whips up a luxury lunch at home: cold soba noodles in homemade kombu dashi with seared mushrooms. Plus, a savvy storage tip for optimal leftovers.

programme.title: Coffee and Carne Gigante
programme.desc: Chef Frankie makes coffee from whole beans and seasons pork carnitas tacos with the leftover grounds.

programme.title: Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
programme.desc: From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

programme.title: Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup
programme.desc: Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

programme.title: Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties
programme.desc: With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

programme.title: Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart
programme.desc: Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

programme.title: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon
programme.desc: From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

programme.title: Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse
programme.desc: Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

programme.title: Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu

programme.title: Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
programme.desc: Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

programme.title: Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
programme.desc: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

programme.title: Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
programme.desc: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.desc: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

programme.title: Not Your Nonna's Risotto
programme.desc: Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

programme.title: Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
programme.desc: Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

programme.title: Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
programme.desc: Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

programme.title: Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples

programme.title: Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
programme.desc: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Guayabera World
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Yucatán Meats
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Let's Play Ball
programme.desc: No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

programme.title: Suppertime Superstar
programme.desc: From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.

programme.title: Citrus Sunshine
programme.desc: Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.

programme.title: The Big Game
programme.desc: Brackets are complete and all that's missing is food to fuel your team's run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust.

programme.title: Piece Of The Pie
programme.desc: There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Super Squash
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they're affordable, abundant, and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Potato Variety Show
programme.desc: Frankie's slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, a staple for any Struggle kitchen.

programme.title: Bananas For Bananas
programme.desc: As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond basic bread.

programme.title: Fancy Pants Pasta
programme.desc: Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

programme.title: Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.
