programme.title: VEGETABLES
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Life's Milestones
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Best of Baked Dishes
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Kneading Dough
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: A Dinner Party
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Vegetable Favorites
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Welcome to my Home
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: FOCACCIA
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: The Fish Market
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Surf N Turf
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Italian Cakes
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Italian All Stars
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Eggs and My Chickens
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Respect The Ingredients
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Game Day Bites
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: A Stovetop Dinner
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Make it Zucchini
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!

programme.title: Something For Everyone
programme.desc: Butternut squash and cannellini beans; a quick and easy dessert of strawberries and balsamic; roasted spaghetti squash with spicy tomato sauce.

programme.title: Spice it Up
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Chicken for Dinner
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: The Winter Vegetable Punch
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Steak Night With London Broil
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.

programme.title: FRESH PASTA
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.

programme.title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.

programme.title: Cooking as a Kid in New York
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Freedom & Independence
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: A Cheesy Craving
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Holiday Celebrations & Special Occasions
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: A Day at the Market
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Starring Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Eggs All Day
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Italian Essentials
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: The 1970s Italian American
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: An Italian Cookout
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Rethink Risotto
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Just Braising
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil reigns in Lidia's kitchen, and in this episode she teaches the viewer how to use it from appetizer to soup to dessert. She'll start with a delicious Tomato and Bread Salad - a delicious tossed salad of country bread and juicy ripe tomatoes known as panzanella; a nourishing Rice and Lentil Soup and a Cannoli Napoleon, a new twist on the old cannoli: ricotta cream with crunchy almonds and chocolate layered between fried pastry.

programme.title: A Meal To Make You Smile
programme.desc: Radicchio, endive, apple and pecorino with cheese toasts; skilled ricotta mini meatloaves dressed in a mushroom sauce.

programme.title: Tiny Kitchen, Big Flavor
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Cheese Please!
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: An Easy Holiday
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: A Kind Gesture
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Storytime with Grandma
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Gnocchi
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Eggs: All Different Ways
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Crespelle
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Party Fixings
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: In this episode, the oven is on for the fish dish, the vegetable dish and for the chicken drumsticks! Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a Baked Fennel with Tomatoes and oozing Cheese. She then creates a Rollatini of Sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon and white wine.

programme.title: Stretch Your Meal
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich travels the country visiting men and women who've worked quietly in the shadows and now find themselves thrust into the spotlight by crises facing the country in 2020. From coast to coast, Lidia follows dedicated police officers, firefighters, paramedics, military and medical workers, and observes the prominent role that food plays in these first responders' lives.

programme.title: Is Dinner Ready?
programme.desc: Spicy sheet pan pork chops and broccoli; how to revive leftover soup for an easy weeknight meal; apricot jam half-moons.

programme.title: RISOTTO
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a Creamy Risotto alla Milanese with Saffron and Marrow bone followed by a Succulent Quail Stuffed with Italian Sausage and Mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Berries.

programme.title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.

programme.title: An Easy Effort
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: More Family Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Carry on Tradition
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Bolognese
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Fish Festa
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: The Flavors of Northern Italy
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Simply Delizioso
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: DOUGH AND CRUSTS
programme.desc: Italians will wrap anything in dough, whether it's savory or sweet, and still have time for a classic. Lidia begins this meal with a savory Zucchini and Rice Crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of Zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, who has the sweet tooth in the family, joins Lidia for this segment.

programme.title: Crazy for Mushrooms
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Familiar Flavors
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: A Perfect Weeknight Meal
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Family Meal
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Southern Italian Salads
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Sweetest of Sweets
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: CRESPELLE
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: What's Baking
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: The Power Of Food
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Let's Make Dinner
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Breakfast at Lidia's
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Italian American Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: The Olive Grove
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Potato, Potato
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: A Bright Summer Feast
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: FISH AND SEAFOOD
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Crowd Pleasers
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: It's Pasta Night!
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: The Oven is On
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Baking Bread
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: The Next Chapter
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Super Simple Seared Lamb Chops
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Garden of Goodness
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Sweet and Savory
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Prepare the Harvest
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Sympony of Pasta
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: The Sweet Life in Italy
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Who Betrayed Jean Moulin?
programme.desc: Search for the traitor who gave up the leader of the French Resistance.

programme.title: Thirty To One: The P-51 Mustang
programme.desc: Meet a pilot who single-handedly beat back the Luftwaffe in an iconic warbird.

programme.desc: Look inside a fearless battalion's incredible 2,000-mile journey to victory.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big City
programme.desc: Many diverse forces shaped L.A., bringing cultural richness and tensions, and making it a global arts hub.

programme.desc: Es el día del santoral de Plácido y quiere festejarlo con una cena, pero la falta de presupuesto complica el plan. Además, Tulio se fue de la casa y la familia debe decidir si Gertrudis se va o se queda con ellos.

programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: Double Dealing
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: Jack of All Shades
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Game of Chance
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Things We Do For Love
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Little White Lies
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: Rules of Disengagement
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: Once Were Heroes
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.desc: Pepa's son, Tyran, comes to town with old baggage in tow; Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend, Sam; drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran; Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike.

programme.title: The Cupid Shuffle
programme.desc: The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head; Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana, but her grand plan backfires; Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention; after a blow-up, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

programme.desc: Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes; Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip; family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames; Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time.

programme.title: Tee Tee With the Good Hair

programme.title: SRS Crown Championship Part 2
programme.desc: The championship is presented by Eukanuba and features the best retrievers in the world competing in hunting, field trial and hunt-savvy scenarios along with the exuberance of dogs on the dock in the SRS Super Dock competition.

programme.title: Rifle Camp at the Raven
programme.desc: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

programme.title: Rifle Camp at the Raven
programme.desc: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

programme.title: 50 Acres in 5 Days
programme.desc: The boys are on the Raven in Missouri trying to plant 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in five days before heading out west to kick off the hunting season.

programme.title: Bow Camp at the Dirty Bird
programme.desc: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

programme.title: Solitude
programme.desc: The personal story of a Purple Heart veteran who finds quiet healing in the woods, one arrow at a time.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Will Cooper finally trades three years of tough times for triumph in his quest to tag an out-of-state buck with a bow.

programme.title: Two More Turkeys Down in Mississippi!!!
programme.desc: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

programme.title: Missouri Turkey Tour!
programme.desc: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

programme.title: 150 Inch + Kansas Giant
programme.desc: In this episode Slade travels to Kansas to try and bag one of the Midwest's most impressive deer!

programme.title: Into the Green
programme.desc: Capts. Scott and Steve fill up their Yeti cooler to make a big run from Plantation Boat Mart in the 36' Invincible into the green Gulf waters, hoping to do battle with some sea monsters.

programme.title: Silver and Gold
programme.desc: A peaceful day of reef fishing in Islamorada turns into a kingfish and yellowtail frenzy for Captains Scott and Steve.

programme.title: Wahoos on Kites
programme.desc: It only takes three fish to fill the Yeti cooler when Capt. Scott kite fishes the top for wahoo and Steve pulls a big mutton snapper off the bottom.

programme.title: Stock Island Grocery Run
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island to load their coolers with cobia and huge yellowtail snapper.

programme.title: Kingfishing West of Key West
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve sail west of Key West to battle with big kingfish and end up with plenty of meat for the smoker.

programme.title: Key West Yellowtail and Cero on Fly
programme.desc: Captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker prove themselves to be among the top charter boat and tournament captains in offshore fishing; follow their journey to fishing destinations as they share the techniques that have driven their success.

programme.title: Between the Tides
programme.desc: Join Capt. Jonathan Moss as he revisits some special moments from Season 8.

programme.title: Killer Bee
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it's time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43' custom ACI Catamaran Killer Bee.

programme.title: The Glass Is Always Cleaner
programme.desc: Friendships are at stake when the new casino owner tries to make changes at the Montecito; Danny loses confidence that he will be the new president; Sam continues therapy and decides to befriend the new hotel concierge.

programme.title: Head Games
programme.desc: Cooper secures a beauty pageant for the Montecito, but things go awry when someone sabotages the contestants; Sam thinks she sees a casino guest murdering a woman but has difficulty trying to convince Danny that she is not hallucinating.

programme.title: Run, Cooper, Run
programme.desc: Danny and Mike head to Cooper's suite for a meeting but find themselves in the middle of a crime scene; Piper (Camille Guaty) tries to help the son of one of the casino's big clients learn to be cool.

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemon Bars
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Piper dresses up in various costumes to scare her co-workers; Cooper insists on shadowing Sam.

programme.title: Adventures in the Skin Trade
programme.desc: Danny and Mike see a strip-club owner get physical with a stripper; Delinda advocates for better rights for exotic dancers in the city; Piper enlists Sam's help to find a racy video that she does not want people to see.

programme.title: It's Not Easy Being Green
programme.desc: The casino plays host to an environmentally friendly conference; Danny questions Delinda's plan for a new "green" lifestyle; Sam tries to capitalize on high rollers looking for love; Cooper shows a new side of himself when a mystery woman arrives.

programme.title: My Uncle's a Gas
programme.desc: Danny gets a surprise visit from the fire marshal and his alcoholic uncle; Mike keeps an eye on the casino's Hand on Hard Bodies competition; Cooper forces Sam to help a contestant; thieves break into the casino.

programme.title: The High Price of Gas
programme.desc: The effects of the Montecito robbery reverberate all over Las Vegas; Danny tries to fend off federal agencies' accusations; Delinda wants Cooper and Sam to apologize to each other; Piper and Mike help a widow carry out her husband's last wishes.

programme.title: A Cannon Carol
programme.desc: Mike begins to doubt his place in Las Vegas; Sam invites a client to visit the casino for the holidays; Delinda and Piper plan a Hot Santa contest to win the casino charity competition.

programme.title: I Could Eat a Horse
programme.desc: Danny and Mike head to Wyoming to buy a horse; Delinda looks for a new chef for the casino restaurant; Piper hides from her ex.

programme.title: 3 Babes, 100 Guns and a Fat Chick
programme.desc: Bounty hunters and FBI agents descend on the Montecito when they track a fugitive from justice to the area; Sam tries to help one of her whales pick up the pieces of his broken life; Piper throws a post-New Year's party, and cash starts rolling in.

programme.title: Secrets, Lies and Lamaze
programme.desc: Piper gets in trouble with the gaming commission; Sam gets caught speeding and must attend traffic school; Danny and Delinda meet a "perfect" pair at a parenting class.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Breakfast
programme.desc: Sam gets help from The Cleaner when she needs to get rid of evidence after her whales visit a strip club; Mike and Piper (Camille Guaty) sample the wares of a hot new bartender they are trying to lure to the Montecito.

programme.title: 2 on 2
programme.desc: Piper's evaluation for the Concierge of the Year award tests her skills; Danny and Mike decide to play in a two-on-two basketball competition where the stakes become more than they anticipated.

programme.title: Win, Place, Bingo
programme.desc: Cooper, Danny and Mike are suspicious of a man (Terry Bradshaw) who has a nearly perfect winning streak; Sam's whale brings his grandmother (Kathryn Joosten) to the casino to play bingo.

programme.title: Three Weddings and a Funeral
programme.desc: Thieves try to steal a rare stamp that is up for auction at the Montecito, taking Danny, Piper, Mitch and the surveillance room hostage; Mike's mom discovers that he is married.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Big Ed Deline leads a surveillance team charged with maintaining security at one of the largest casinos in Sin City; protégé Danny McCoy must foil a team of high-tech cheats.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas, Stays in Vegas
programme.desc: The body of Danny's childhood friend is found in the desert; Ed conceals the identity of an ultraconservative senator; Mary contends with an actor who takes his role as King Arthur too seriously.

programme.title: Donny, We Hardly Knew Ye
programme.desc: Danny and Ed become suspicious when a high roller cashes in chips but never plays a hand; Ed's cousin meets the woman of his dreams at the roulette wheel and decides to get married immediately.

programme.title: Jokers and Fools
programme.desc: Cheaters plan to score $10 million with the help of the best pit boss in Vegas -- Nessa; a psychic warns Mary of an audience member's death; Sam plays matchmaker for a lonely lady.

programme.title: Groundhog Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Ed hunt for a sexual predator targeting hotel guests; Danny and Mike suspect three MIT students of planning an electronic heist when they arrive with the latest high-tech equipment.

programme.title: Semper Spy
programme.desc: When Ed leaves Danny in charge of the hotel, a computer glitch causes hundreds of guests to be locked out of their rooms.

programme.title: Pros and Cons
programme.desc: A con artist (Alana De La Garza) scams the daughter of a surveillance specialist into exchanging counterfeit chips for cash; Mary helps a couple down on their luck with tickets to see Wayne Newton.

programme.title: Luck Be a Lady
programme.desc: A stalker disrupts a pop diva's (Sheryl Lee Ralph) performance at the hotel; Ed reunites with a former partner (Mimi Rogers); Sam tries to evict a guest lodged in a prime suite who refuses to gamble.

programme.title: Year of the Tiger
programme.desc: Sam brings one of the premier high rollers (Michael Paul Chan) to the Montecito, promising to arrange a rare reunion with his two high-profile daughters.

programme.title: Decks and Violence
programme.desc: Danny and Ed search the hotel when a member of a husband-and-wife magic troupe vanishes; Mike runs into an old friend from college.

programme.title: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: Ed and Danny referee clashes between rival camps during the premier boxing match of the year; Danny threatens to cancel the fight after the theft of a manager's prosthetic limb; Ed questions the fluctuating odds on an undercard fight.

programme.title: Hellraisers and Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Ed's former CIA buddy (Alec Baldwin) installs a security system which immediately detects a breach made by a computer hacker staying at the hotel.

programme.title: The Night the Lights Went Out in Vegas
programme.desc: A hotel guest is shot dead on the casino floor during a blackout; trapped Danny and Mary rehash old feelings; Mike and Ed are locked inside the surveillance room.

programme.title: Things That Go Jump in the Night
programme.desc: Danny and Ed introduce a suicidal guest (Jon Lovitz) to the thrill of gambling; Sam gets cozy with a client, then his fiancée (Paris Hilton) comes to town.

programme.title: Die Fast, Die Furious
programme.desc: An action star (Jean-Claude Van Damme) dies while executing a stunt for his latest movie; a rival casino host squares off against Sam for the patronage of a high roller.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Sam follow a high roller to New Orleans to collect $5 million; an unruly clan of farmers gathers for a family reunion; Mike coordinates the world's largest wet T-shirt contest.

programme.title: You Can't Take It With You
programme.desc: A resident (Sean Astin) wins the jackpot at a slot machine, then fakes his own death; Ed's mother (June Lockhart) regales the staff with stories of her son's childhood; a couple uses coupons to avoid spending any money in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Nevada State
programme.desc: An escaped murderer seeks revenge against Sam for testifying against him; the hotel hosts a statewide cheerleading competition; Nessa discusses the merits of Manchester United with a trio of rowdy British soccer fans.

programme.title: Sons and Lovers
programme.desc: Thieves snatch a guest's wallet before he can spend his winnings; the security team assesses a suspicious machine with an unusually high payout pattern; Ed discovers Jillian (Cheryl Ladd) has been hanging out with singer Mark McGrath.

programme.title: The Strange Life of Bob
programme.desc: Nessa tries to uncover the truth about a mystery man (Christian Kane) known only as "Bob the rover"; Danny hunts for a peeping cameraman; Sam enters an eating contest.

programme.title: Family Jewels
programme.desc: Danny asks Mike for his technical expertise when someone steals $5 million in diamonds from one of the guests.

programme.title: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Nessa attempts to calm a blackjack player with a bomb strapped to his chest, while Danny discovers there is another bomb planted by an accomplice.

programme.title: Always Faithful
programme.desc: Danny and Mike search for the source of the phony $100 bills suddenly surfacing at the casino, despite Danny's urgent letter requiring him to report back to active duty.

programme.title: Have You Ever Seen the Rain?
programme.desc: Danny surprises everyone by returning home, but his memories of the war make it hard for him to adjust to life; Ed, Mike and Danny must track down three suspicious characters who are making mischief in the casino.

programme.title: The Count of Montecito
programme.desc: Danny and Sam try to figure out the tactics of a ring of card counters; Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) professes his love for Nessa, much to her dismay; Ed and Danny deal with an archaeologist's find near the hotel pool.

programme.title: Blood Is Thicker
programme.desc: Ed is framed for murder when enemies from his past resurface, and Danny and Mike take matters into their own hands; Sam, Mary, Nessa and Delinda select what they believe are the perfect tenants for their new investment property.

programme.title: Catch of the Day
programme.desc: Danny and Mike investigate when a truckload of lobsters is stolen en route to the hotel, while Sam travels across the country to get replacement lobsters.

programme.title: Good Run of Bad Luck
programme.desc: Danny agrees to help the wife of an ex-Marine by watching her baby while she attends an interview, but he becomes concerned when she doesn't return; Sam hosts a man who intentionally throws his money away to confound his soon-to-be ex-wife.

programme.title: Games People Play
programme.desc: Nessa questions everything Ed has told her about her father when a mysterious woman tells her that he is still alive and wishes to contact her.

programme.title: Montecito Lancers
programme.desc: Danny and Mike prepare their youth football team for the Casino League championship game and search for a missing casino employee and aspiring inventor, who is the father of one of the team members.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Mike work to help Dr. Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and Detective Woody Hoyt (Jerry O'Connell) as they try to solve the murder of a high-stakes gambler who appears to have had many enemies.

programme.title: Degas Away With It
programme.desc: Ed uses past connections and old-school tactics to track down the thief who stole a priceless work of art from the Montecito, leading to a tense reunion with his former partner (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas

programme.title: Sin amor
programme.desc: Teresita intenta tranquilizar a Marcia diciéndole que nada de lo que Fernando hizo con Lety fue por amor; Fernando le dice a Omar por qué piensa que Lety los delató.

programme.title: Lágrimas al mar
programme.desc: Marcia le informa a Carolina sobre la cancelación de la boda; Lety las escucha y se culpa por todo lo que está pasando.

programme.title: La miserable
programme.desc: Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

programme.title: Casarse con el mar
programme.desc: Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

programme.title: Espíritu intranquilo
programme.desc: Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.

programme.title: Con la muerte tan cerca
programme.desc: Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

programme.title: Transformada
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.

programme.title: Nuestra belleza
programme.desc: Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.

programme.title: Cuestión de confianza
programme.desc: Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.

programme.title: No te rindas
programme.desc: Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

programme.title: Ideales
programme.desc: Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.

programme.title: Sin ti
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

programme.title: Nuevas experiencias
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.

programme.title: Ahogado en un bar
programme.desc: Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

programme.title: Paseo en moto
programme.desc: Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.

programme.title: Alianza femenina
programme.desc: Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

programme.title: El dueño
programme.desc: Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.

programme.title: Golpeado en un bar
programme.desc: Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

programme.title: Cocinando juntos
programme.desc: Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.

programme.title: El día del certamen
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.

programme.title: Fórmula mágica
programme.desc: Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.

programme.title: Acuerdo
programme.desc: En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.

programme.title: Sánchez y Rosales
programme.desc: Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.

programme.title: Perdonar
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: Cancelación
programme.desc: Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.

programme.title: Desencuentros
programme.desc: Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.

programme.title: Lety está de vuelta
programme.desc: Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.

programme.title: Un posible futuro
programme.desc: Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.

programme.title: Los licenciados
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.

programme.title: Relación laboral
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.

programme.title: Vicepresidente
programme.desc: Luigi les cuenta a Carolina y Aldo por qué don Humberto nombró a Lety presidenta de Conceptos; Lety nombra a Tomás vicepresidente financiero de la empresa.

programme.title: Corajes
programme.desc: Fernando y Simón llegan al bar donde están las del cuartel; Simón hace corajes porque Paula María baila con otro y Fernando se molesta porque hay un hombre junto a Leticia.

programme.title: Ultimátum
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que les contó a las del cuartel que ya no son novios; el juez concede a Conceptos seis meses para liquidar su adeudo a Filmo Imagen antes de entrar a remate.

programme.title: Nuevo proyecto
programme.desc: Luigi presenta a Aldo con Marcia y le dice que trabajará con él en un proyecto ajeno a Conceptos; Alicia ofende a los pasajeros del autobús antes de bajar.

programme.title: Nuevas oficinas
programme.desc: Raúl instala a Tomás en la antigua oficina de Olarte y, al ver a Alicia hablar con Aldo, piensa que hay algo entre ellos; Lety toma su lugar en la que fue oficina de Fernando; Aldo y Fernando se conocen.

programme.title: Cizaña
programme.desc: Leti le pide a Alicia que cite a Marcia en la sala de juntas y Alicia aprovecha la oportunidad para meter cizaña.

programme.title: Plan de rescate
programme.desc: Marcia le ordena a Luigi presentarse en la junta; Lety informa al consejo sobre las concesiones que dictó el juez y propone el proyecto que pensó con Aldo para reunir el dinero.

programme.title: Reorganizando la empresa
programme.desc: Luigi anuncia que renunciará a Conceptos al terminar la inauguración de la feria gastronómica y pide que contraten a Jazmín.

programme.title: Los dos galanes
programme.desc: Alicia le expresa a Marcia su desacuerdo sobre ser su secretaria; Marcia le pide su renuncia y Alicia se retracta; Aldo le pide a Fernando hablar a solas para conocerse.

programme.title: Antipatía
programme.desc: Lety presenta a Tomás con Aldo; Tomás le dice a Lety que Aldo no le cae muy bien porque Alicia quiere con él.

programme.title: Lo que se regala
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que está segura de que Lety y Fernando van a verse porque él la apoyó en todo durante la junta; Lety le dice a Tomás que no pudo tirar los regalos de Fernando y por eso se los regresó.

programme.title: Con el corazón

programme.title: Lake St. Joseph Fishing

programme.desc: Go DIY turkey hunting with a bow and a shotgun on this double hunt episode of Wingmen.

programme.desc: Ed Welsh with Millennium treestands bowhunts the early season with TCO for a big Kansas whitetail then Jackie Bushman hunts the late season in Kansas with his muzzleloader.
