programme.title: Squirrel Masters Classic/Alabama
programme.desc: GAMO holds it's annual squirrel hunting competition in Alabama, then Jackie hunts Alabama.

programme.title: La familia que crece unida
programme.desc: Una mujer le guarda rencor a su hermana por errores del pasado, pero debido a la enfermedad de su mamá las mujeres encuentran fuerza para superar los problemas juntas.

programme.title: El lobo pierde el pelo
programme.desc: Isa conoce a Mario, un chico que la hace comprender muchas cosas y seguir firme en sus decisiones y valores. Una tarde su novio y su madre se presentan en la cafetería para pedirle que regrese a Guadalajara. Isabel decide terminar con Ernesto.

programme.title: No por miedo a fallar
programme.desc: Una señora le pide a su hija que se vaya de la casa porque su patrona cree que ella le robó dinero. Cuando la chica va a su casa un hombre la secuestra, la lleva a una casa y trata de prostituirla.

programme.title: Diablo te hiciste
programme.desc: Miriam es una adolescente que, por falta de atención de sus padres, cae en una broma pesada por internet. El padre de Miriam es aficionado a ver páginas en internet de adolescentes y encuentra las fotos de su hija en una página prohibida.

programme.title: Al que no habla
programme.desc: Una chica va caminando con un amigo de la escuela de regreso a su casa, cuando el novio de su mamá los encuentra en la calle y amenaza al chico para que se aleje de ella. Cuando llegan al departamento, el novio de la mamá intenta manosear a la chica.

programme.title: Lo que no fue en tu año
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.

programme.title: Homenaje a Roberto Gómez
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el Poncholín colorado y el Poncho del ocho, un homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: El amor que se hace nudo
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chica que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que ella lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.

programme.title: Donde hubo fuego
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.title: El que nace pa' maceta
programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: El Valiente Vive, hasta que el Cobarde Quiere
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.

programme.title: Ojos que no ven
programme.desc: Lucía es una chica que descubre la infidelidad de su novio. Lucía tiene una infección en los ojos y su madre compra un medicamento económico que le provoca ceguera. La joven culpa a su mamá de su desgracia, pero pronto su vida cambiará.

programme.title: No todo lo que brilla es oro
programme.desc: Una joven cantante conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.

programme.title: En casa del ladrón
programme.desc: Una joven está obsesionada con la muerte de su padre, cree que él quiere comunicarse con ella para darle un mensaje. La joven cree que el mejor amigo de su papá y su mamá son amantes, y que ellos tuvieron que ver con la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Cara de beato
programme.desc: Un joven debe dinero de drogas y decide irse a vivir con sus tíos a otra ciudad para escapar, pero lo siguen para cobrarle todo el dinero que debe. El joven se roba la tarjeta de su tía y saca el dinero, pero el cobrador se lo quita todo.

programme.title: A cada uno le toca escoger
programme.desc: Un joven se va de su casa porque su padrastro lo maltrataba, su abuela se pasa buscándolo, pero él no quiere regresar con su familia y conoce a una mujer que lo utiliza para robar al lado de otros niños de la calle.

programme.title: The Iron Profligate
programme.desc: A detective and self-confessed profligate and martial artists of the highest caliber team up to smash an illegal gambling house and drug smuggling outfit.

programme.title: Masters of Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Experience a Tai Chi Chuan class with Master Cui Zhongsan in Beijing and listen to him explain the history and philosopy of Yang style and how and why it developed as a seperate style from Chen Tai Chi. Visit the small remote Chen village, the birthplace of Tai Chi and learn the history of Tai Chi with the Chen family. It was here that Yang style was born through Chen student Yang Luchan.

programme.title: Angry Dragon
programme.desc: A young kung fu fighter from Canton saves his village from the tyranny of the Japanese with his amazing kung fu techniques.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Robert Redfeather
programme.desc: Robert Redfeather is the founder of the Apache Knife System. He is also the Secretary of the Interior for the Chiricahua Nation. He is also the founder of the Apache Knife Foundation. Redfeather is one of the leading authorities for the Apache Knife. He hosts a number of seminars across the globe and was inducted in the Martial Arts History Museum's Hall of Fame in 2018.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 11
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leads to Tono-sama being treated like a VIP and the rest of everyone being scorned.

programme.title: Unbeaten 28
programme.desc: The Unbeaten 28 is a rare gem! The leader of the Hong Kong clan is Yen Chan Ying (Mark Long), a ruthless warlord who is a master of 26 styles, which gives him a tremendous advantage over normal martial artists. One day, a proud man dares to step forth and speak against Yen Chan Ying's villainy. Sadly, the man's fighting skills are not as immense as his bravery, and he goes down to Yen Chan Ying like so many others before him.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 8
programme.desc: The shogun falls in love with a mysterious woman who Jubei suspects to be a spy. With the Shogun's life on the line, Jubei and his ura-yagyus must hurry to find the truth before its too late.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub the Movie
programme.desc: A ronin Hai Itto (Manya Kinnosuke) is an assassin who travels with his son Daigoro (Okada Jizo) in a baby carriage. Itto is asked by the vassals of the Maruoka clan, whose feudal lord has been assassinated and the clan destroyed, to kill their underling, the official assassin Gunpei Yagyu (Katsuhiko Watahiki). Gunbei is the son of Retsudo Yagyu (Rentaro Mikuni), the chieftain of the Yagyu underlings.

programme.title: The Shaolin Kids
programme.desc: When a ruthless Premier Hu Wei Yung, writes a self-incriminating letter that ends up in the wrong hands (the delicate but deadly hands of the lovely Su Lin), he will stop at nothing to get it back. Premier kidnaps Miss Lin's father and she risks everything to free him.

programme.title: Kickboxer King
programme.desc: From the team that brought you "Ong Bak".Two kickboxers, Joe and Johnny, battle it out for supremacy, against a backdrop of gang violence, drug abuse and police corruption. Who will emerge victorious, and at what price?

programme.title: 52 Masters: SHUKOKAI KARATE with Ed Smith
programme.desc: Sensei Ed Smith trains Will in the secret art of power punching.

programme.title: 52 Masters: KOBAYASHI SHORIN-RYU with Marques McCammon
programme.desc: Will studies under Sensei Marques McCammon.

programme.title: Dance of Death
programme.desc: Kung fu girl, Angela Mao tricks two equally matched kung fu masters who duel every five years into teaching her both of their styles so she can take revenge against a vicious gang that killed her friends. The teachers stand by during her fights and count the number of moves that she uses to defeat her enemies so they can prove which of them is superior. This is one of the best choreographed Angela Mao movies, and is recommended for viewing by all Angela Mao fans.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 21
programme.desc: Through a series of manipulations and deceit, an evil mastermind causes a rift between the three for the extended season finale.

programme.title: Ninja Condors 13
programme.desc: Top Ninja Alexander Lo stars in this action packed ninja fest as a member of an evil gang of 13 ninjas. However, he wants to leave the gang and live a peaceful life, but the only way to exit the gang is by death.

programme.title: Dragon and Snake in the Spider's Web
programme.desc: Security Officer Lu (Tan Tao Liang) is following a case of a mysterious gun smuggler. His investigations lead him to Madam Wu, who appears to be the link between smuggler and client. Luckily for Lu, Wu seems to have a soft spot for the womanizing gambler known as Chang (Wong Tao) so Lu arrests him in the hope that, with a little brute force, he will assist in the case.

programme.title: Mystery of Chess Boxing
programme.desc: Lee Yi Min stars as a young boy, Ah Pao, who wants to learn kung fu so that he can avenge his father's death at the hands of the Ghost Faced Killer (Mark Long). The Ghost Faced Killer, meanwhile is hunting down a number of clan leaders who all conspired to have him killed. Before attacking, the killer always throws down his "ghost face killing plate," a decorated metal plate with a red face. He then uses his distinctive five elements style.

programme.title: Mantis Fists and Tiger Claws of Shaolin
programme.desc: When the local thugs harass a restaurant owner's daughter Shuang Shuang (Choi Chuk-Guen), a newcomer Pai (John Cheung) fends them off. When Pai goes off to the local brothel to find his long lost sister, the thugs rape Shuang Shuang, but get killed mysteriously later in the woods. The father of the thugs, Hung Chun Piao (Dean Shek), believes that Pai committed the murders and confronts him..

programme.title: The Ninja Showdown
programme.desc: A poor, young fighter Tony witnesses the injustices caused by the Purple Ninjas and vows to train to become as skilled as them to one day defeat them in battle. Help is at hand from Ninja Gordon, who gives him the necessary skills since he himself is on a mission to eliminate the Purple Ninjas. Will both fighters get what they have lost and cut off the evil ninjas purple heads?

programme.title: Golden Showdown
programme.desc: You'll know them when you see them! Returning to his home town and finding it overrun with ruthless gangsters led by Mr Chore, Richard sets out to stop their nefarious activities. A bloody conflict ensues, and when Richard's father is killed in retaliation he finds out that the law is no better. But then his sister is killed and Richard finally snaps, taking on the gang single-handedly and loaded to the very last bullet.

programme.title: Deadly Strike
programme.desc: The new police chief (Bruce Li) arrives in a small provincial town. He's been charged with bringing a dangerous gang to justice. But within seconds, the chief provokes a showdown with his lazy deputies. Realizing that they are not up to the job, he enlists the help of some of his prisoners, offering pardon to those who survive the encounter with the gang.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 4
programme.desc: Hatsuuchi Suzuki, an official of the Tateyama Clan's Edo residence, attacked the axe-suke of Oshu, an Orizuke, and was beaten to death in a vicious revenge attack. Ittou, however, arrived a day too late. Itto met Hatsuuchi's children, Aya and Soichiro, who appealed to him for revenge. Itto slays Rikuzo in the gambling hall, Abukuma while eating, and Asuke who was with a woman, one after another. When he kills Asuke, he tells the woman who was with him: "If you are asked, you must answer.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 7
programme.desc: The bounty is at stake, and Hai Itto and Daigoro are declared publicly wanted criminals. The bounty hunters are always flocking to the scene, eager to get their hands on the 1,000 ryo bounty.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 7
programme.desc: The lone wolf made a promise to a dying undercover Yagyu ninja, to bring his wife to be together with him in the afterlife. This promise led Itto to a village with only women, whose sole purpose is to give birth to new ninjas.

programme.title: Born a Ninja
programme.desc: A Japanese scientist tries to conceal a deadly formula, but an undead ace and his ninja devils are determined to use it to cause mischief and mayhem. It is up to Lung, a master of the lost art of Hocus Pocus, to keep evil at bay and prevent mass destruction on a global scale.

programme.title: Red Beard (Akahige)
programme.desc: The film follows Dr. Kyojo Niide, known as Red Beard, who runs a charity clinic in Edo (now Tokyo). Red Beard is a stern but compassionate physician dedicated to helping the poor and downtrodden. The story revolves around his interactions with a young, arrogant medical student named Yasumoto, who starts working at the clinic under Red Beard's mentorship. Initially, Yasumoto is disdainful and lacks empathy, driven by his ambition and elitist attitude.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Al Leong
programme.desc: Al Leong is considered one of the most impressive kung fu practitioners of our generation. In the early 1970s, when kung fu was barely on the map, Leong stepped into the tournament circuit and became one of the most dominant figures in martial arts history. With his long, wavy hair, his prominent Fu Manchu moustache and wielding one of the heaviest of weapons (the kwan do), he paved a path for the rest of kung fu to follow.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 5
programme.desc: "The lone wolf receives an assassination request to eliminate a feudal lord from a member of his own clan. The Yagyus are using this opportunity to hunt down the lone wolf and exploit the clan's weakness at the same time."

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Yagyus continue to use any method necessary to kill the lone wolf. Meanwhile, Ogami is shocked to receive an assassination request from a woman with uncanny resemblance to his late wife.

programme.title: 52 Masters: RON THOMAS
programme.desc: Will gets all choked up when he trains with fellow Karate Kid franchise veteran Ron Thomas (Karate Kid, Cobra Kai).

programme.title: Soldier Champion aka American Force 6: Soldier Champion
programme.desc: Escape is the only way to survive. Larry Rourke, leader of the resistance to an oppressive South-Asian country, escapes a prison for political dissidents, but it is all part of a master-plan by the head of the prison, who intends to use him to locate the rebel headquarters. Joined by an anti-government cult, the Full Moon Alliance, Rourke must ensure that the government's armies do not catch them before they can find salvation.

programme.title: Three Avengers
programme.desc: When two acrobats are fired for fighting with punks in the audience, they go to live with an aunt who's being pressured to sell her house for a real estate development. The developer's nasty son, Lee Fu, decides to muscle the sale.

programme.title: 52 Masters: LUA aka KAIHEWALU LUA with Michelle Manu
programme.desc: Will spends time with his friend Michelle Manu, a master of the devastating Hawaiian martial art of Kaihewalu Lua.

programme.title: The Magnificent Duo
programme.desc: Leopard, seeks to dominate the opium market. Who can stop him? The Magnificent Duo is ready and willing to take on the gangsters and their Japanese ninja allies in their righteous fight to stand up for the poor and challenge the wicked.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: James Lew
programme.desc: Winning the Emmy Award for Most Outstanding Stunt Coordinator for the "Luke Cage" Marvel series, James Lew began his career as one of the greatest forms and weapons competitors in the tournament circuit of the 1970s. Gracing the cover of countless magazines, Lew teamed up with Carrie Ogawa-Wong to become the greatest duo performance team in history. This earned them the cover of Inside Kung Fu magazine which became the most popular action cover of all time.

programme.title: Raging Rivals
programme.desc: Shanghai in chaos at the turn of the century, a place where gangsters gather and commit all manner of evils. Ghost Kick Silver Fox faces off against the Shanghai Tigers in a battle for control of the lucrative casinos and brothels, but the victor will be the one who ultimately can train the best kung fu killers.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Steve Sexton
programme.desc: Steve "Roadhouse" Sexton is a man who put his martial arts skills to the test everyday. An instructor in Korean Hapkido, Sexton was also the muscle for many bars and places where "tough guys" gather. These are the stories of a man who was shot at, and stabbed but used his martial arts skills to overcome some of the most deadly encounters.

programme.title: 52 Masters: GERALD OKAMURA
programme.desc: Will's lesson with Kung Fu master and martial arts film star Gerald Okamura (G.I. Joe Rise of Cobra, Big Trouble in Little China) takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho (Jackie Chan), an undercover operative for the CIA, decides to give up his career and marry his girlfriend, Gillian (Amber Valletta). First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Once Upon a Crime
programme.desc: On their way to Monte Carlo, Monaco, Marilyn (Cybill Shepherd) and her husband, Neil (James Belushi), meet several other married couples, including Julian (Richard Lewis) and Phoebe (Sean Young), who are traveling with a lost dog they plan to return to its wealthy owner for a large reward. But, when the dog's mistress is murdered, the travelers become the prime suspects, and Inspector Bonnard (Giancarlo Giannini) is determined to track them all down.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programme.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
programme.desc: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

programme.title: Good Boy!
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, dogs arrived on planet Earth from a faraway star with plans to take over the world. Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: "Questions Only"; "Newsflash"; "Let's Make a Date"; "Hats"; "Props"; "Number of Words"; "Dead Bodies."

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: Greg Proops, Rory Bremner, Colin Mochrie, and Ryan Stiles show off their skills for quick-thinking comedy in games such as "Secret," "Sports Commentary," "Home Shopping," and "Dead Bodies."

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: "Film & Theater Styles"; "Secret"; "Let's Make a Date"; "Duets"; "Hats"; "Picture"; "Party Quirks"; "Moving People."

programme.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
programme.desc: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

programme.title: Sci-Fi, Snapshots, and Sleepy Campers
programme.desc: A dad-daughter duo runs the block, sci-fi chaos, newlywed fails, and campfire madness.

programme.title: Jed Plays Solomon
programme.desc: Granny's plan to stop Pearl's yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.

programme.title: Duke Steals a Wife
programme.desc: Jed's bloodhound Duke takes on the role of matchmaker for his master and a glamorous woman from France.

programme.title: A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
programme.desc: A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

programme.title: Herby Gets Drafted
programme.desc: Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

programme.title: Give Me Your Walls
programme.desc: Rob's living room needs to be painted so he hires a colorful master painter from Rome.

programme.title: Never Name a Duck
programme.desc: When one of Ritchie's two pet ducks dies, it seems as if the Petrie family has lost one of its human members.

programme.title: Jed Buys the Freeway
programme.desc: A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.

programme.title: Jed Becomes a Banker
programme.desc: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

programme.title: Boris and Natasha
programme.desc: The silly spies from The Bullwinkle Show foil a mad scientist whose lab is in a Mount Rushmore nose.

programme.title: Exit Strategy
programme.desc: James must move in with his girlfriend of three months after being evicted from his place, and soon he discovers that he doesn't want to be with her anymore. His hope is to get her to break up with him but still let him sleep on the couch.

programme.title: Dog Days
programme.desc: Elizabeth is a charming anchorwoman who seeks advice from her dog's therapist. Tara is a spunky barista who dreams of a life beyond the coffee shop. Daisy is a dog walker who's enamored with a client. Garrett pines for a woman while trying to keep his adopt-a-dog business afloat. The beloved canines in their lives soon start to influence their careers, friendships and romantic relationships in funny and unexpected ways.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: After a bite from a genetically altered insect gives him superhuman abilities, teenage loser Rick Riker (Drake Bell) decides to use his powers for good. Donning an uncomfortably tight costume, Rick becomes a mysterious crime fighter known as The Dragonfly. But standing in the way of truth, justice and the American Way is an evil villain known as The Hourglass, who plans to become immortal by sucking the life force out of anyone who gets in his way.

programme.title: A Holiday to Remember
programme.desc: Returning to her South Carolina hometown reunites a recently divorced mother (Connie Sellecca) with her first love (Randy Travis).

programme.title: Lazer Team
programme.desc: After stumbling across a crash site, four misfits must use an extraterrestrial battle suit to save mankind.

programme.title: Ginger Minj: Bless Your Heart
programme.desc: International drag superstar Ginger Minj discusses dysfunctional family etiquette, haunted dolls and the infamous "Florida Man."

programme.title: Lazer Team 2
programme.desc: The members of Lazer Team travel through a wormhole to rescue their friend.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: Taco Shop
programme.desc: A bitter rivalry forms when a taco truck parks right across the street from a taco shop.

programme.title: Elephant Tales
programme.desc: African animals help two elephants search for the poachers (Patrick Bry, Xavier Clément) who captured their mother.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Crooks (Jackie Chan, Louis Koo) grow attached to the baby they kidnapped.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Jellyfish Explosion and the Kraken
programme.desc: Tom Hird blows up a van to explain how jellyfish sting, reveals why anemones tear themselves apart, meets an aquatic odd couple and uncovers the truth behind the mythical kraken.

programme.title: Mako Shark and Blue Sea Dragons
programme.desc: Tom Hird unveils the world's fastest fish, wraps himself in tin foil to show how crabs molt, reveals the starfish's unsavory eating habits and explores why blue sea dragons are deadly.

programme.title: Urchin Eyes and Bloodhound Sharks
programme.desc: Tom Hird reveals the secrets of a sea urchin's spikes, swims with tiger sharks to see if they can sniff out blood from a mile away and shows how cuttlefish change color in a flash.

programme.title: Moray Eel and Barracuda
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird reveals the moray eel's jaw-dropping abilities, blows bubbles to show how a snail can sail, showcases the fearsome barracuda and shows how the whale shark survives on plankton.

programme.title: Lobster Power and Sniper Worms
programme.desc: Tom Hird explores the lobster's crushing claw, a sea cucumber's alarming survival tactics, the super-sucking jaws of pipefish and why bobbit worms are true ocean nightmares.

programme.title: Octopus Escapees and Blue Whale
programme.desc: Tom "the Blowfish" Hird demonstrates how octopus fit through tiny gaps, explains why coral glows, meets a crab that tastes with its toes, and uncovers why the blue whale is the biggest animal ever.

programme.title: Bowhead Whale and Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Tom "The Blowfish" Hird explores the hammerhead's sensational snout, a cuttlefish's inky getaway and pays homage to a true oceanic headbanger: the bowhead whale.

programme.title: Humpback Whale and Spinner Sharks
programme.desc: Tom "The Blowfish" Hird meets a real-life blowfish, demonstrates how humpback whales feast, reveals the architectural genius of a sand mason worm and jumps in the pool to hunt like a spinner shark.

programme.title: Sperm Whale and Maverick Tuna
programme.desc: Tom reveals why penguins waddle, explores the sperm whale's nautical noggin and more.

programme.title: Elephant Seals and Sea Gooseberry
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird meets a seal with an enormous schnoz and more.

programme.title: Sea Turtles and Stylish Squids
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird reveals the bobtail squid's stylish survival tactics and more.

programme.title: Stingrays and Conger Eels
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird shows how stingrays pierce their prey and more.

programme.title: Saltwater Crocodile and Polar Bear
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird explores the polar bear's smelling superpowers, challenges a velvet swimming crab to a drag race and demonstrates why the saltwater crocodile is the king of crunching.

programme.title: Sea Otters and Frog Fish
programme.desc: Tom the Blowfish Hird explores the truly rockin' sea otter, shows how frog fish are ocean ninjas, reveals the odd way corals mate and explains how one worm's waste is another man's treasure.

programme.title: Seal Snouts and Sharpshooters
programme.desc: Tom Hird dives with seals to investigate their super-sensitive whiskers, tests his shooting skills against an archerfish and fires a cannon to show the power of a mantis shrimp's punch.

programme.title: Fastest
programme.desc: The need for speed is an essential skill to survive in a hostile world-and, for some animals, can be the difference between catching a meal or becoming dinner. But which animal is the fastest?

programme.title: Builders
programme.desc: Heavy metal marine biologist, Tom The Blowfish Hird, scours the globe to find the Top 10 most ingenious animal craftsmanship. Which animal will be crowned nature's master builder?

programme.title: Performers
programme.desc: Nature is filled with no shortage of flamboyant creatures. Tom The Blowfish Hird shines the spotlight on outrageous exhibitionists in his search for the natural world's greatest showmen.

programme.title: High Flyers
programme.desc: Whether it's flying in the sky, swinging through the trees, leaping off buildings, or defying gravity, Tom The Blowfish Hird is going higher than ever before to find nature's ultimate highflyers.

programme.title: Hunters
programme.desc: Nature's predators come in all shapes and sizes; whether they use fangs, claws, or teeth, once in their sights, their prey has little hope of survival; these are nature's formidable hunters.

programme.title: Toughest
programme.desc: Whether it's scrapping over breeding rights, enduring extreme conditions, or boasting a supercharged immune system, being tough is essential to staying alive.

programme.title: Aquatic Experts
programme.desc: Life under the waves isn't for the faint-hearted; it's time for Tom "The Blowfish" Hird to don his scuba gear and dive into the Top-10 extraordinary creatures that are true aquatic masters.

programme.title: Smart & Skillful
programme.desc: In nature, brains often triumph over brawn; animals use their wits to beat the competition, stay off the menu, and adapt to their environment.

programme.title: Eat the Plane
programme.desc: Guy Pearce introduces us to three extraordinary innovators feeding the planet by fighting food waste, including a restaurant waste warrior and a passionate food rescuer.

programme.title: Well Beings
programme.desc: Guy Pearce presents three inspirational stories showing how innovators are improving wellbeing and mental health right across Australia.

programme.title: Switch On
programme.desc: Guy Pearce shows how know-how is moving Australia to the front of the green-energy race by creating powerful ideas and change in unexpected places: in the ocean.

programme.title: Grow The Future
programme.desc: Guy Pearce introduces three entrepreneurs helping grow our future, by talking to thirsty crops, boosting protein with crickets, and bringing the ocean.

programme.title: Class of Our Own
programme.desc: Guy Pearce uncovers three innovative programs keeping students engaged through citizen science, leadership in the top office and immersive hologram technology.

programme.title: Watch This Space
programme.desc: Guy Pearce introduces the superstars of the internet of things using rocket design, low orbit satellite tech and low-cost connectivity to prove the sky's the limit.

programme.title: Ending Extinction
programme.desc: Guy Pearce introduces the ingenious Aussies bringing native animals and habitats back from the brink of extinction using robots and some devilishly clever thinking.

programme.title: All Fired Up

programme.title: Healthy to You
programme.desc: Guy Pearce shows how Aussies are using smart tech to bring better health to the bush by flying medicine to those who need it, scanning brains at home and away.

programme.title: Faster Than It's Safe To Go!
programme.desc: Client Michael saves a nostalgic Fiero from junking to electrify it as a gift to his nephew; while Seven laughs at GM's attempt to go Italian, Gadget overhauls it to go faster than is probably safe.

programme.title: No Respect for Internal Combustion
programme.desc: Gadget and Co bash the dirty guts out of a Porsche to get it primed and electrified for the owner's Hollywood movie premiere while getting trippy overhauling a Burning Man art car for an old friend.

programme.title: We Have No Manual for This!
programme.desc: After getting client Lasta the hottest electric Boxster in Hollywood, Gadget gets the DeLorean ripping into the future as the crew bonds while filming a promo video to attract future clients.

programme.title: Eat the Plane
programme.desc: Guy Pearce introduces us to three extraordinary innovators feeding the planet by fighting food waste, including a restaurant waste warrior and a passionate food rescuer.

programme.title: Well Beings
programme.desc: Guy Pearce presents three inspirational stories showing how innovators are improving wellbeing and mental health right across Australia.

programme.title: Indonesia
programme.desc: Jimmy Doherty heads to Indonesia to meet a young British couple, and their 18-month-old toddler, who have abandoned the rat race in the UK for a new life on a tropical island in the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Uganda
programme.desc: Jimmy Doherty travels to Uganda in the heart of Africa to meet a young British couple and their five-month-old baby, who have abandoned the rat race in the UK for a new life on the banks of the River Nile.

programme.title: Yukon
programme.desc: Jimmy Doherty travels to the Yukon wilderness in Canada to find out why an actress and an office worker quit the London rat race for a log cabin in bear country.

programme.title: Apocalypse Cow
programme.desc: Gino and Fred begin in Austria's Zillertal Alps, where melting glaciers highlight climate change; exploring meat's impact, they try vegetarianism and discover innovative culinary alternatives in Vienna.

programme.title: Naked Travellers
programme.desc: In their final journey, Gino and Fred head to Croatia, shocked by over-tourism in Dubrovnik; they explore Mali Ston's shellfish before road-testing Croatia's answer to sustainable travel with agro-tourism, then cross the Adriatic for an adventure.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: We trek onto the second-largest ice sheet in the world, one of the best places to see the impacts of a warming climate; by air we see the stunning ice fjords fed by the majestic glacier behind it.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: We take to the ice by dog sled to see how the Inuit hunt; on board The Kisaq we pass huge colonies of seabirds: guillemots and kittiwakes and giant icebergs, where we see first-hand the effect of climate change as they crumble into the ocean.

programme.title: Walking the Yangtze With Ash Dykes
programme.desc: On the first leg of Ash Dykes' journey along the Yangtze River, Ash must beat the onset of winter and get off the plateau before he gets snowed in.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Ash Dykes follows the Yangtze River through the heart of China.

programme.title: Echoes of the Andes
programme.desc: Explore the origins of the Amazon River in the Peruvian highlands, where ancient wisdom meets modern challenges in the fight to protect fragile ecosystems.

programme.title: Streams of Hope
programme.desc: Amidst the bustling city of Manaus, see how local heroes fight to restore polluted waterways and preserve the cultural heritage of Brazil's indigenous communities.

programme.title: Tides of Change
programme.desc: At the meeting point of river and ocean, witness the power of nature's forces as climate change alters the landscape-and the people-of the Amazon delta.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Peter heads back to the Teasdales' farm where he recently delivered a healthy calf. But this time the pressure is really on, as the expectant mum belongs to Ian's young son, Alfie.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: More Pet Babies
programme.desc: This time we spend the day with some of the world's most beloved pets. Kittens, puppies and baby guinea pigs are some of the babies we have fun with.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Australia and New Zealand
programme.desc: We hang out with the youngsters that live and play in Australia and New Zealand. A baby Koala backpacks around the bush with its mum, join Fur Seal pups for a rocking good time on the rugged shores of New Zealand and bound around with Kangaroo joeys.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Rupert the adored trekking llama is lame and in agony. Can Julian save Rupert's career? Peter pregnancy tests cows. But will all of Arthur's prized herd be in calf? Ruben the lurcher was rescued by elderly local farmers, Jean and Steve Green. But his love of Jean's home cooking might be causing problems. Ellie May, a treasured moggie, is accidentally run over by her devastated owner.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Will Sweetie the sassy staffy hit the sweet spot for Hillary and Jaxson' Can senior snaggletooth George find the perfect retirement home that he has been looking for with ex-pat professional Janice'

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter is struggling to find his feet in his new practice. But when a farmer rushes in with a heavily pregnant sheep who's struggling to give birth, instinct takes over as Peter deals with the emergency.

programme.title: Yorkshire Vet At Christmas Special
programme.desc: Julian Norton and Peter Wright are invited to switch on the Christmas lights at Skeldale and also asked to find a donkey that can be used for the nativity scene.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Two brothers are worried about their cow, who is foaming at the mouth. Peter also has a daunting visit to the Greens' farm. Dusty the cat has an injury, but won't be easy to help. An animal lover finds a pigeon with a deformed leg.

programme.title: Winter Babies
programme.desc: We look at playful youngsters who extract the most fun out of winter. Brown bear babies enjoy this time of the year along with baby snow monkeys enjoying time in hot springs. Tasmanian Devil babies seek out a cosy den.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter tries to save a cow who has suffered a huge prolapse after giving birth. With the newborn calf depending on her mum, the pressure is on.

programme.title: Even More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We return to the zoos to meet up with more babies, wild cat kittens, chimpanzees, and panda cubs are featured.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Matt and David meet equine rock star Jon Bon Pony. Peter treats a farmer's trusty Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail. Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg. Robin aids a pregnant ewe.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter desperately tries to deliver thirteen puppies who are drowning in their own fluid. Saving a sick school guinea pig is a big test for Julian. And on the Greens' farm, Jean throws a surprise party for Steve's 90th.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Is Lane the dachshund pup the perfect match for Arnav and his parents? Can lovebirds James and Melissa win over aloof Aspen, the Japanese Spitz? Finally, will scruffy sweet Caroline find good times with Jay and Christine?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In Staffordshire, Inspector Charlotte Melvin comes to the aid of two Border Collies living in hazardous conditions. And that's not the only thing troubling her; because their owner is struggling to cope...

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter meets his most tricky client yet, Possum the uber-angry pussycat. Nykee the alpaca may have a life-threatening and excruciatingly painful condition. Can Julian save both mum and baby? Peter meets much-loved ram, Diamond, who has eye problems. Working sheep dog, Flynn, has a suspected broken leg. Will Julian be able to get him back to running with his flock?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter Wright needs to act fast to save a cow with heart failure, only to find something unexpected in its stomach. A beagle goes through a difficult birth and a hamster arrives for a simple procedure that ends up proving tricky. Ethel the vulture gets territorial when Peter arrives with a microchip.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A farmer fears his sheep has been shot. But has it suffered an attack by a dog or a fox? Peter's worried about a tawny owl whose eye he removed 18 months ago. Flynn now has a serious problem with his remaining eye, which means his life is in danger.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: It's Sunday morning, but it's no day of rest for Julian as he heads to the Taylors' farm. One of their sheep has prolapsed a few days after he delivered her lamb, and Julian has his work cut out to receive another reward of freshly laid eggs.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter faces a difficult calving at Ed McDonald's farm. The cow is an experienced mum and Ed is an experienced farmer, so Peter senses it's a serious problem.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Will Australian Shepherd Alfie and the Holmes Family find their new mate? Will 'stage-5-clinger' Missy be too much for a first time owner? Will shy shaggy Doug be the right fit for the Billich family?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian rushes over to see worried and confused farmer Joe Holmes. He found one of his cows with afterbirth hanging out, so he thought she'd already calved. But there's no sign of a new arrival, so he suspects she's struggling to give birth.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Can a father and son duo look past Cara the beagle's anxiety and give her a shot? The Ford family look for a new canine companion for their nervous therapy dog Lucy. Plus, Parmigiana's second chance.

programme.title: More Urban Babies
programme.desc: We are back in the towns and cities to visit babies who brighten our lives, some more unusual than you might imagine... Kangaroo joey, raccoon kits and fruit-bat babies.

programme.title: Summer Babies
programme.desc: This time we see the baby animals in the summer. Among the animals featured are tigers, orangutans, and green sea turtle hatchlings.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the veterinary documentary series. New scenes include Dave the baby emu, Dougie the pugnacious parrot, Bobby the police sniffer dog and highlights of a hectic lambing season.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian decides to conduct a fertility test on an unproductive ram. Peter tends to a spaniel that needs major surgery after being hit by a car. Julian has to travel to Thirsk to tend to the wounded following a battle between two terrapins.

programme.title: African Savanna Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: The trainee RSPCA Inspectors' extraordinary year of training is drawing to a close. The students are out on the beat, working real-life cases by themselves and desperate to show they're ready to become full-time Inspectors. They are on probation and only those who consistently meet the standards expected of them by bosses will be offered a job. It's a race against time.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Julian races to an emergency at a local farm where a cow is unable to stand up. She's suffering from a condition called milk fever, caused by calcium deficiency. It's classic, Herriot style vet work and Julian has to be extremely careful with his treatment.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A lamb is rushed to the Huddersfield hospital with a ruptured eye. He needs surgery, but Matt's worried there might be a problem with the lamb's other eye. Peter operates on a Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Julian castrates a miniature pony.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: It's a distressing day for Inspector Anthony Joynes after he's called to investigate the case of Harvey, a Border Collie so thin it had to be put to sleep on humane grounds. But there's more upset in store when Anthony turns up at Harvey's registered address and finds another dog just days away from death.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal rescues three dogs from an abusive owner but things take a distressing turn when it's revealed they're suspected to be Pit Bulls and so may have to be put to sleep.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A 4-week-old lamb is rushed in to see Peter. After being unwell recently, it suffered a prolapse, and Peter thinks the solution might just lie in the practice's kitchen. Julian attends to a dog that's been kicked in the face by a horse.

programme.title: Episode 9

Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: The South
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As plants begin to show their early growth, Monty gets plenty of plants for free when he demonstrates how to make the most of herbaceous perennials. Nick Bailey shares plans for his new garden in Northamptonshire and shows how to create a container garden ideal for those on the move. Frances Tophill discovers more ways to use cut flowers as she visits a florist in Devon.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With spring gaining momentum, Adam Frost gets to work on his veg plot and plants his first lot of potatoes. Joe Swift meets a garden designer who, facing the challenge of two awkward, adjoining plots, transformed them into wonderful, cohesive spaces. And Rekha Mistry demonstrates how to grow the perfect onion from seed and has a go at growing cotton.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty adds some interest to the spring garden. He also sows peas and shallots, has some thrifty tips for petunias, and plants lilies in pots. Carol Klein visits Mothecombe Gardens in Devon, which has been designed specifically for pollinators, with swathes of nectar-rich daisies and lavender.

programme.desc: Monty prepares for late spring and summer, while Toby Buckland revels in some spring planting at Melbourne Hall in Derbyshire. Rachel de Thame meets a dahlia grower who once worked at the White House.

programme.desc: Lee County, FL officers respond to reports of a fight with a machete; officers in Indian River County, FL are called to a domestic incident involving a child.

programme.title: A Bizarre Case
programme.desc: A truly bizarre case where Agent Brian Moody tracks down two fugitive friends and picks one fugitive up just as he's released from jail on other charges.

programme.title: Across State Lines
programme.desc: Bounty Hunter, Bob Thorton's team shows a lot of tenacity in tracking this fugitive across state lines.

programme.title: Deadlift Killer
programme.desc: Body builder Doug and his deputy sheriff girlfriend Tracy bond over their love of weightlifting, but all they do lately is quarrel. When Doug's body is discovered encased in concrete, all fingers point to Tracy. But Tracy insists that it's physically impossible and she's being framed by the same sheriff's department she once worked for.

programme.title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon's badly decomposing body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend's mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. But when they learn their relationship has recently been rocky, no one is sure whether they're hunting for a victim...or a killer.

programme.title: A Date with Death
programme.desc: When a nurse dies after ingesting a sedative, a fellow medical professional comes under question and a horrifying truth is revealed.

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So, his mission continues.

programme.title: Roided Out
programme.desc: Man offers to go "toe-to-toe" with five officers who confront him.

programme.title: Stolen UTV
programme.desc: Police confront three men accused of joyriding on a city-owned UTV.

programme.title: Body at the Dock
programme.desc: A body is found floating at a dock in a North Florida creek; police initially suspect a motive of robbery, but the victim's complex love life suggests otherwise.

programme.title: Surviving Prison
programme.desc: How do inmates survive within the strict confines of Singapore's only women's prison?

programme.title: Carlos Hallowell
programme.desc: Vivica examines the interrogation tapes connected to the violent axe murder of 57-year-old Denise Hallowell, who was discovered by her 17-year-old adopted son in her room with an axe embedded in her skull.

programme.title: The Quadruple Murder of Saint-Andéol
programme.desc: In Saint-Andéol-Le-Château, Rhône, the Lyon Research Brigade investigates a quadruple homicide where an entire family was killed with the same weapon.

programme.title: Ashley Pegram
programme.desc: 28-year-old Ashley Pegram, a mother of three, was devastated when her partner and father of her youngest son died in a car accident. Lonely, she turned to dating apps and hastily arranged to meet a man she had just met online on April 3, 2015.

programme.title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: When a Texas oil tycoon's badly decomposing body is found in his beauty queen girlfriend's mansion, police fear the worst and issue a nationwide alert to find her. But when they learn their relationship has recently been rocky, no one is sure whether they're hunting for a victim...or a killer.

programme.title: Amelia Dyer
programme.desc: Putting on the front of a kindly baby farmer, someone who takes in the children of unwed mothers for a fee, Amelia Dyer became the most prolific killer in British history.

programme.title: The Cleveland Torso Murders
programme.desc: Cleveland, Ohio became a notorious city in the 1930s, struggling under the Great Depression, crime and corruption even before a serial killer prowled its streets.

programme.title: The Devil
programme.desc: In June 2011, a man is arrested for brutal domestic homicide. This horrible story is the story of a sadistic pulsion.

programme.title: Carlos Hallowell
programme.desc: Vivica examines the interrogation tapes connected to the violent axe murder of 57-year-old Denise Hallowell, who was discovered by her 17-year-old adopted son in her room with an axe embedded in her skull.

programme.title: Privileged Princesses
programme.desc: Spoiled suspects are knocked down a peg by police.

programme.title: The Bathtub Killer
programme.desc: A woman allegedly drowns in the bathtub, but her husband's story doesn't add up; when his second wife also drowns two years on, police's fears are confirmed.

programme.title: The Mystery of the Headphones
programme.desc: A killer evades justice for the murder of Diana Hanson for 38 years until genetic genealogy can identify him.

programme.title: The Hunt for Precious Jane Doe
programme.desc: In August 1977, the body of a young girl was discovered by blackberry pickers in Everett, WA. She had been strangled and shot. Investigators launched a two-tiered investigation.

programme.title: Love to Loathe
programme.desc: In New Port Richey, Florida, a sex party has a gruesome ending, while on the outskirts of London, England, farmyard animals could hold the key to what's happened to a missing wife.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: In Denver, Colorado, a mistress plots revenge when she's dumped, and in a small community north of Stockholm, Sweden, a deeply religious woman believes she's receiving messages from God - to kill.

programme.title: Dark Minds
programme.desc: In Chicago, Illinois, a millionaire meets an exotic dancer with a secret agenda, and in Marion, Ohio, friends suspect the worst when a wife and mother goes missing.

programme.title: Stranger Danger
programme.desc: An internet love triangle leads to deception and murder near Buffalo, New York. On the outskirts of London, England, a romantic stroll through the woods ends with a brutal attack.

programme.title: Momma Knows Best
programme.desc: In Merrillville, Indiana, there are deadly secrets between family members, while near Manchester, England, a late night flower delivery proves a test run for murder.

programme.title: Officer Assisted Water Rescue (10-18-2025)
programme.desc: Baton Rouge, La. officers respond to shots fired while a Daytona Beach, Fla. pursuit ends with a water rescue; Christian County, Mo. officers search for a suspect who fled on foot and officers in Knox County, Tenn. talk to a concerned neighbor.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: This female fugitive is an alleged drug dealer and has an incredible amount of $100,000 in warrants for her arrest. A man is wanted for probation violations and apprehended at his mother's house, but the Bounty Hunters receive more resistance from the family than the fugitive.

programme.title: Probation Officer
programme.desc: The Bounty Hunters hunt two fugitives wanted for felony battery and grand theft when their probation officer has not been able to track them down. Agents are forced to set up a meeting with Dallas police to strategize the arrest of man who is wanted for probation violations.

programme.title: The Conservative Killer
programme.desc: A politician's ex-wife is murdered; police risk everything to expose the powerful suspect and bring justice through a daring sting.

programme.title: Kayleigh Haywood
programme.desc: Kayleigh Haywood was 15 years old when 27-year-old Luke Harlow contacted her out of the blue online. He bombarded her with messages. From this intense grooming, Luke Harlow persuaded Kayleigh to lie to her parents in order to meet him.

programme.title: The Perverted Preacher
programme.desc: A Mobile preacher, killed his wife for discovering his abuse of her daughter. The truth emerges when the girl, pregnant with his child, reveals all.

programme.title: Shawn Grate
programme.desc: Shawn was a charming, good-looking boy who often abused women. He went to prison at 22 for choking his pregnant girlfriend and returned for hurting another. By 2010, he had three children with different mothers-and then women began to disappear.

programme.title: Murder of Annie Le
programme.desc: Yale graduate student Annie Le disappeared just days before marrying her college sweetheart. As investigators uncovered evidence of a violent struggle, they realized Annie had fallen victim to a horrific murder.

programme.title: Drunk at the Airport
programme.desc: A man trying to board a flight is stopped by staff when they observed apparent signs of intoxication.

programme.title: Stolen UTV
programme.desc: Police confront three men accused of joyriding on a city-owned UTV.

programme.title: Casey Anthony
programme.desc: The 2008 disappearance of 2 year-old, Caylee Anthony ignites a national media firestorm when her attractive, young mother, Casey, becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: In Losing It
programme.desc: In Singapore's only women's prison, about 800 inmates eat, sleep and live together in close confines.

programme.title: Ben Blakeley
programme.desc: Seemingly a kidnapping, Jayden Parkinson's disappearance garnered national headlines after the young teen went missing after telling friends and family she was pregnant.

programme.title: Tracking Down the Predator
programme.desc: In the wake of a chilling abduction in Remoulins, Nîmes investigators, aided by critical witness testimonies, embarked on a relentless pursuit of a known Belgian offender.

programme.title: Carly Ryan
programme.desc: Carly Ryan thought she'd found her dream boy in 18-year-old musician Brandon Kane. They chatted online for 18 months under her mother's watch. Unbeknownst to them, both Brandon and his stepfather were personas created by 50-year-old Garry Newman.

programme.title: Two Keys to Murder
programme.desc: In Newport Beach, California, millionaire medical innovator Bill McLaughlin is living a luxurious life inside the gated community of Balboa Coves - until he is shot six times in his own kitchen. When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: The Richmond Murders
programme.desc: In 1878, a widow is killed in her own home, and the killer is her own servant; the young servant does not only kill and dismember her employer, she also steals her clothes, her property and her identity.

programme.title: Mary Pearcey
programme.desc: Until its closure in 2016, Madame Tussauds' Chamber of Horrors was one of the museum's oldest and most popular attractions.

programme.title: Under Pressure

programme.title: Body on the Shore
programme.desc: A missing woman's body is found washed up on the shore of a tidal estuary; CCTV, DNA and a cryptic note lead investigators to her ex-partner.

programme.title: The Knifepoint Rapist
programme.desc: A young woman out jogging is attacked and viciously raped at knifepoint. The perpetrator continues his reign of terror by raping another five times over the next nine years.

programme.title: The Murder of Little Marise
programme.desc: In 1964 Hazleton, Pennsylvania, the brutalized body of 9-year-old Marise Chiverella is discovered after she disappears walking to school. Half a century later, a teen prodigy in investigative genetic genealogy helps detectives solve this crime.

programme.title: Faking It

programme.title: Body of Evidence

programme.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
programme.desc: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.title: Bitch Slap

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.
