programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: When a series of uncanny deja vu events begin to occur, a man must re-examine his tragic past and instinct.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Concrete Canyons
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: From Embers
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her husband Ron, Lily finds herself navigating a challenging new reality with her son Kevin. As they settle into a modest apartment, Lily's encounter with their neighbor Marty brings up an unexpected revelation about Ron's suspicious death. Marty is an alcoholic and his passion for music is only surpassed by his love for his daughter Chloe. When Lily delves deeper into the mystery surrounding Ron's demise, she forms a bond with his co-worker Angela.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Lilies Not For Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Paradox Effect
programme.desc: estranged from her daughter because of a past life of drug-abuse, Karina is taking all the steps she can towards being the mother she needs to be. One night Karina hears the discharge of a muted weapon and a body breaking through heavy glass. Looking up, she locks eyes with the man who pulled the trigger and she is captured. The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: Part I: Leaving
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Part II: On The Trail
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Part III: The Plains
programme.desc: Gus and July save Lorena from Blue Duck, but at a deadly cost. Jake runs with a bad crowd and pays the price. July accepts that his wife has left him and stays on at Clara's with his newborn son.

programme.title: Part IV: Return
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Inhabitants
programme.desc: Going against the wishes of their family members, Olivia and her boyfriend, Francis, move to California for an exciting new life. However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: After party
programme.desc: Paco lleva una relación intensa con Simone, lo cual le provoca un desmayo por tanta fiesta.

programme.title: Silvia en Canadá
programme.desc: Silvia viaja a Canadá para ver a un chico que conoció en internet, sin saber que todo es una broma de Pedro y Benito. Tito sigue los consejos de Germán para ser un buen policía, pero todo le sale mal.

programme.title: Aviso de desalojo
programme.desc: La dueña del edificio le dice a Germán que les informe a todos los vecinos que va a vender el inmueble y que deben desalojarlo en una semana. Silvia cree que su gran amor puede ser Luis.

programme.title: Los héroes del nortec
programme.desc: Zacarías no puede hacer nada legalmente para detener el reality y para colmo, le pasa hasta lo inimaginable. Por fin comienza su rehabilitación y después de estar con un sensei, se siente listo para regresar con la banda.

programme.title: Casi famoso
programme.desc: Albertano es estafado por una mujer que promete volverlo un famoso cantante, pero durante su presentación todos descubren la farsa de su voz.

programme.title: The show must go on
programme.desc: Zacarías logra entrar a Televisa en el final del reality y se convierte en el cuarto finalista.

programme.title: Mujeres peligrosas
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor conocen a dos mujeres que les hacen creer que están interesadas en ellos, pero solo quieren su dinero.

programme.title: Cita peligrosa
programme.desc: Vítor acepta tener una cita con una mujer casada y usa a Albertano para distraer a su amiga, pero el esposo de la mujer aparece y tienen que fingir tener una relación.

programme.title: O se callan o se largan
programme.desc: Leopoldito llora demasiado y los vecinos se quejan del ruido exigiendo que los corran del edificio. Además, Gaby padece depresión posparto y rechaza a su propio bebé, por lo que su familia trata de ayudarla.

programme.title: No marches con la marcha
programme.desc: Plácido se reencuentra con un excompañero en Acapulco y decide aparentar que es millonario. Además, después de una marcha, Adolfo decide rebelarse contra La nena, pero su rebelión termina mal.

programme.title: En el mar la vida es más sabrosa
programme.desc: Martina encuentra trabajo y se siente más independiente. Además, La Nena y Adolfo tratan de convencer a Licha para irse de vacaciones a Acapulco y así deshacerse de ella, pero alguien más termina de viaje.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Carlos consigue trabajo como "wedding planner" en Acapulco, pero sus bodas no resultan ser como promete. Mientras tanto, Tere apuesta con una vecina que Gaby puede aprender a tejer.

programme.title: Lucha Interna
programme.desc: Detienen a Doña Lucha al creer que es la jefa de una banda de marchistas, para sacarla de la cárcel, sus hijos juntan sus ahorros con los que comprarían su regalo del 10 de mayo. En la cárcel los policías creen que ella mató a un delincuente.

programme.title: Lucha Interna
programme.desc: Le dan trato preferencial a Lucha y hasta un famoso narcotraficante se pone a sus órdenes porque cree que mató a un delincuente. Albertano se corta un mechón por el cual le dan mucho dinero. Lucha se enoja muchísimo al enterarse.

programme.title: El súper episodio del súper
programme.desc: La familia Peluche va al supermercado y luchan por un lugar de estacionamiento. Federica se pone celosa de que Ludovico habla gustosamente con la señorita de la carnicería.

programme.title: Juego de roles
programme.desc: Federica intenta seducir a Ludovico, pero él no se da cuenta y ella llora porque perdieron la llama de la pasión. Ludovico y Federica buscan como reavivar su matrimonio y hacen un juego de cambio de personalidad.

programme.title: Pacosterona
programme.desc: Paco tiene una falla en la intimidad con Simone, así que Betochas le recomienda una uróloga de primera.

programme.title: Tulum, tenemos un problema
programme.desc: Mientras Simone se va a Riviera Maya, Paco la espía en redes sociales.

programme.title: La jaula de las vecinas
programme.desc: Luis consigue una cita por internet y decide comportarse como Pedro para impresionar a la chica. Silvia se molesta con Magda porque le robó su suéter preferido.

programme.title: Un tatuaje para Alejandra
programme.desc: Alejandra decide irse a vivir con Pedro y Luis porque Magda no la deja tatuarse. Lorena y Frankie le piden a Vanesa que cuide a Benito, pero ella sale y lo deja cuidando a su abuelo.

programme.title: El quinto finalista
programme.desc: Los finalistas cantan y el público enloquece. Al llegar el momento de anunciarse el ganador, Zacarías da un conmovedor discurso.

programme.title: Piloto de carreras
programme.desc: Dada su experiencia como chofer de microbuses, ahora que es rico, Vítor decide convertirse en piloto de carreras y, con Albertano, crea la escudería "Los Guapos".

programme.title: Reina por un día
programme.desc: Natasha se encuentra con una presuntuosa y molesta excompañera de la escuela. Vítor y Albertano deciden hacer pasar a Natasha por una exitosa millonaria que vive rodeada de lujos y servidumbre para poner a la presumida en su lugar.

programme.title: Reloj no manches las horas
programme.desc: El jefe de Plácido le pide cuidar su preciado y antiguo reloj, pero él lo pierde en la playa. Victoria pasa por cambios extraños en su cuerpo y nadie quiere explicarle qué le sucede.

programme.title: No te vaigas subcomandanta, no te vaigas
programme.desc: Plácido y Carlos son solicitados para animar una fiesta, pero los invitados son un público difícil. Nena se pone celosa debido a una visita inesperada.

programme.title: Se atormenta una vecina
programme.desc: Carlos presiente que se acerca un huracán en Acapulco, pero nadie le cree. Además, el administrador ha puesto una nueva regla después de cachar a Gaby y a Plutarco despidiéndose.

programme.title: Qué pedí yo
programme.desc: Martina tiene una clienta muy molesta que exige su dinero, pero, para su sorpresa, es amiga de Gaby y Plutarco. Mientras tanto, la Nena tiene una llamada importante y la familia piensa que engañará a Adolfo.

programme.title: Una patita de conejo fresca
programme.desc: Albertano le manda a María la llave de su cuarto para que saque sus cosas, pero ella entiende que le pide que se mude con él, con su llave tiene una pata de conejo de la buena suerte, pero al ensuciarse, María la tira y le compra una pata nueva.

programme.title: Sed de triunfo
programme.desc: Doña Lucha aprovecha el corte de agua en la colonia para vender unas cubetas que tenía apartadas. María se pone celosa de la nueva ayudante del equipo de fútbol, Citlali, mientras que Albertano se la pasa en la banca por ser mal jugador.

programme.title: Valle del Nabo
programme.desc: El novio de Bibi, Manuel, la invita a Valle del Nabo a pasar el fin de semana. La familia de Bibi los alcanza en casa de Manuel. Manuel termina con Bibi por ser amargada y rara.

programme.title: Día de las Madres
programme.desc: La familia P. Luche festeja el Día de las Madres de una manera muy particular. Ludovico intenta componer el baño, pero un plomero muy guapo lo ayudará.

programme.title: El candidato de Toña
programme.desc: Macedonio empieza a coquetear con Toña, pues se ha lanzado como candidato en la alcaldía. Así que Brayan Daniel acudirá a Paco y al Borrego para evitar este romance.

programme.title: Vota por mulata
programme.desc: Macedonio toma represalias obligando a Paco y al Borrego a negociar una tregua.

programme.title: Tesoro no perdido
programme.desc: Don Roque escucha gritos extraños y cree que se trata de un fantasma. Alejandra quiere unirse a una banda, pero los integrantes la engañan para que los deje ensayar en su casa.

programme.title: Cartas que asustan
programme.desc: Pedro y Benito deciden jugarles una broma a los vecinos y comienzan a mandar cartas con amenazas terroríficas; Vanessa tiene un gallo muy enfermo que se muere, pero los vecinos creen que murió Don Roque.

programme.desc: Don Roque escucha gritos extraños y cree que se trata de un fantasma. Alejandra quiere unirse a una banda, pero los integrantes la engañan para que los deje ensayar en su casa.

programme.title: Cartas que asustan
programme.desc: Pedro y Benito deciden jugarles una broma a los vecinos y comienzan a mandar cartas con amenazas terroríficas; Vanessa tiene un gallo muy enfermo que se muere, pero los vecinos creen que murió Don Roque.

programme.title: El quinto finalista
programme.desc: Los finalistas cantan y el público enloquece. Al llegar el momento de anunciarse el ganador, Zacarías da un conmovedor discurso.

programme.title: Piloto de carreras
programme.desc: Dada su experiencia como chofer de microbuses, ahora que es rico, Vítor decide convertirse en piloto de carreras y, con Albertano, crea la escudería "Los Guapos".

programme.title: Reina por un día
programme.desc: Natasha se encuentra con una presuntuosa y molesta excompañera de la escuela. Vítor y Albertano deciden hacer pasar a Natasha por una exitosa millonaria que vive rodeada de lujos y servidumbre para poner a la presumida en su lugar.

programme.title: Y el ganador es
programme.desc: Mientras festejan el final del reality, el autobús deja a los héroes tirados en la carretera. Pasan la noche con una familia que lleva 40 años de muertos.

programme.title: Empresarios
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano deciden que lo suyo es ser jefes, y por ello compran una fábrica para producir accesorios para automóvil.

programme.title: Rancheros
programme.desc: Asustados por la inseguridad y temiendo perder su fortuna, Vítor y Albertano deciden comprar un rancho e irse a vivir al campo, pero los peligros de la ciudad no son nada comparados con el terror que acecha en ese lugar.

programme.title: Socio repartidor distinguido
programme.desc: Justito quiere pasar el examen de niños genio, pero cuidar a su hermanito podría arruinarlo. Además, Plácido está decidido a regresar a México, pero una tarea en Acapulco lo hará dudar de su decisión.

programme.title: Una nana explotada
programme.desc: Un descuido provoca que la cocina explote, por lo que deberán conseguir dinero para arreglarla. Mientras tanto, Plácido está desesperado por ver a su familia, así que idea un plan para volver.

programme.title: Departamento madre
programme.desc: El departamento de abajo queda en renta nuevamente y la familia López buscará una forma de rentarlo. Mientras tanto, hay una oportunidad en el colegio de genios, por lo que Justito podría dejar a sus papás.

programme.title: Siniestro en el antro
programme.desc: Inauguran el local de Víctor, pero pronto la fiesta se convertirá en un escenario de horror y pánico. Juan Carlos intenta sobornar a un agente federal. La Felina recibe una visita inesperada.

programme.title: Conexión presidencial
programme.desc: En medio del caos, Sebastián ayuda a Rutila. Necesita un buen abogado para presentar las quejas al presidente, luego de que un guardia le quitara el celular. Le llaman la atención a Rivero.

programme.title: La jugada de Terán
programme.desc: Omar muerde el anzuelo que le tiende Rodrigo y se presenta con Castillo en busca de Rútila. Los periodistas lo están esperando. Para no verse involucrado, destituye a Rodrigo.

programme.title: Los Casillas frente a frente
programme.desc: Víctor confiesa que ya no puede más con tanto odio. Aurelio tiene una propuesta para él. Se llevan a Pilar. Rodrigo piensa en deshacerse de Paloma. Mónica debe explicar su nexo con Tony.

programme.title: Cita sangrienta
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana y Víctor pactan un encuentro, en que uno de los dos ganará la pelea a balazo limpio. Aurelio amenaza a Mónica: coopera para dar con el asesino de Nazareno o deja de ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El plan inesperado
programme.desc: Rivero entra de incógnito a la cárcel, lleva un uniforme para Evelyn. Mónica insulta al presidente y lo echa de la casa. Colón y Salazar preparan un gran golpe al Cártel de los Soles.

programme.title: Infeliz encuentro
programme.desc: Juan Carlos enfrenta cara a cara a Pastrana y se lleva una sorpresa. Evelyn y Carla se conocen por medio de Rivero y unen esfuerzos para desenmascarar a Omar. Paloma huele el divorcio.

programme.title: Robo cibernético
programme.desc: Aurelio planea todo para intervenir la cuenta de Rutila, quiere sacar cinco millones de dólares. Ismael, molesto con su padre. Se cae el negocio de Mónica. Piensa en Rutila para lavar dinero.

programme.title: El punto débil
programme.desc: Pastrana piensa en el punto débil de Aurelio para vengarse. Colón y Rodrigo hablan de él y el ascenso de la droga en Estados Unidos. Rutila nota que la robaron. Doble 30 y Mónica planean la última carga.

programme.title: El imperio de Casillas
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma su traición a Feyo Aguilera. Le sugieren no enfrentar a las Maras y las Emes, que el gobierno lo haga, pero él rechaza la idea. Víctor quiere recuperar a Mónica. Rastrean a la Tata.

programme.title: Un remolino de poder
programme.desc: Una furibunda Rutila encara a su padre, por robarle su dinero. Pastrana ubica a uno de los hijos de Aurelio. Mónica reclama a Víctor la trata de blancas. Penumbra intenta extorsionar a Javier.

programme.title: Plan sangriento
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana llega a Colombia para vengarse de los Casillas. Ordena el primer asesinato. Interrogan a Arelys y, asustada, informa sobre Juan Carlos y Pina. Rivero vigila a Dalvio y la Tata.

programme.title: Casillas vs. Doble 30
programme.desc: Doble 30 le ofrece tres toneladas de droga a Aurelio. Casillas protesta. El paramilitar lo amenaza con entregarlo a las autoridades o a Víctor. Mónica pide que la dejen ir. Víctor se deprime.

programme.title: El escudo ante la guerra
programme.desc: El recado de Tony llega a oídos de Aurelio. Casillas enfurece por la muerte de su hijo, Nazareno. Piensa en la guerra que se desatará y cómo cuidarse. Tocan el corazón de la Felina.

programme.title: Siniestro en el antro
programme.desc: Inauguran el local de Víctor, pero pronto la fiesta se convertirá en un escenario de horror y pánico. Juan Carlos intenta sobornar a un agente federal. La Felina recibe una visita inesperada.

programme.title: El plan inesperado

programme.title: Infeliz encuentro
programme.desc: Juan Carlos enfrenta cara a cara a Pastrana y se lleva una sorpresa. Evelyn y Carla se conocen por medio de Rivero y unen esfuerzos para desenmascarar a Omar. Paloma huele el divorcio.

programme.title: Escándalo a la vista
programme.desc: La periodista Carla Uzcátegui se alista a denunciar el vínculo del presidente Omar Terán con los narcos. Aurelio recibe la funesta noticia. Conmovido, deduce que Tony es el asesino de Víctor.

programme.title: El presidente, un sicario
programme.desc: Omar Terán fragua el asesinato de Paloma y chantajea a Jaime para que lo haga o tendrá que pagar por el crimen de la polaca, que él encubrió. La Niña quiere vengar la muerte de Víctor.

programme.title: Callar a un testigo clave
programme.desc: El presidente venezolano le pide a Aurelio que mate a un testigo, para evitar que hable en contra de los "narco sobrinos". Salazar activa un operativo que sirva de imán para atraer a Casillas.

programme.title: Más de una baja
programme.desc: Skinny hace su primer "trabajo" con Aurelio. El Greñas se confiesa con Ismael y lo regaña por soplón. El funeral de Víctor es el punto de concentración y la Tata comete una imprudencia.

programme.title: Rodean a los Casillas
programme.desc: Aurelio sorprende a Mónica con Isidrito, enfurece y la encañona, ella hace lo mismo. Alba trata de evitar una tragedia. Ismael informa que Rivero y el ejército están sobre ellos.

programme.title: Drones, balas y allanamiento
programme.desc: La Marina y la DEA allanan el rancho de Casillas, pero no sin antes intercambiar disparos. Aurelio, la Niña, Vitamina, el Chatarrero y Mónica se esconden. Dalvio tiene un camión lleno de coca.

programme.title: Condenados a morir
programme.desc: Ismael le muestra a Aurelio la foto de un cartel colocado por los padres de Esperanza. Casillas llama a Juan Carlos y le advierte, con vulgaridades, que además de su hija, alguien más morirá.

programme.title: Declara o destapan la olla
programme.desc: El presidente debe reconocer su vínculo con los Robles y anunciar que Casillas está vivo; de lo contrario, la opinión pública sabrá eso y más. Tony admira a Mónica y hasta parece coquetearle.

programme.title: Rivero firma su sentencia
programme.desc: Rivero chantajea al presidente para que dé la cara al país o se sabrá la verdad. Le advierte que sabe que destruyó evidencia, pero que él tiene documentos reveladores. Omar contacta a Casillas.

programme.title: Rutila en la mira
programme.desc: Tony y Filemón organizan la cacería a Rútila. Omar pide 48 horas para hablarle al país. Aurelio le hace una propuesta a Pilar. Eunice se encarga de advertirle sobre su fama de mujeriego.

programme.title: Callan al informante
programme.desc: Rutila se resigna a que Sebastián tenía marcado su destino, por soplón. Aurelio se encargará de Tony. Rodrigo, Evelyn y Erica tienen todo listo para grabar al presidente. Evelyn, bajo anonimato.

programme.title: Contra la pared
programme.desc: Rivero difunde un mensaje por TV que pone en una encrucijada al presidente. Le advierte que está a tiempo de salvar al país. Aurelio tiene la solución y le dice a Terán, que siga sus instrucciones.

programme.title: Morir, antes que entregarse
programme.desc: Hay un tiroteo entre los bandos de Rodrigo y Aurelio. Rutila interviene al saber que Rodrigo corre peligro. Este, escondido junto a Evelyn, espera lo peor. Casillas ordena frenar a su hija, como sea.

programme.title: Al pie de la letra
programme.desc: Omar dice y hace lo que le manda El Señor de los Cielos. Rodrigo es un traidor, aliado de una oficial prófuga y del líder del cártel de Chicago. Casillas triunfa en nombre de una conspiración.

programme.title: ¿Traición a la patria?
programme.desc: Los militares ejecutan la orden de cateo. Están tras una pista del crimen de Rivero. Si Uzcátegui interfiere con la justicia, podría ser acusada legalmente. La grabación está a salvo.

programme.desc: Pilar se sincera con Aurelio y le pregunta si ella terminará como sus exmujeres. Decide seguirlo a México. Aurelio hace planes de negocios con Ninon y ella no puede ocultar que le atrae.

programme.title: Triángulo de amor
programme.desc: Ninón coquetea con Aurelio, pero sus ganas de quedarse con él, provocan una investigación y el deseo de sacarla de su camino. Pilar reclama las escenas seductoras y él propone un trío.

programme.title: Ninón se encarga de su rival
programme.desc: Ninón no soporta a Pilar, así que Ahmed y otros matones a su servicio cumplen con la orden de la Madame. Vitaminas y Zopilote la buscan. Miranda, lista para ocupar el lugar de la Tata.

programme.title: La estampida de Esperanza
programme.desc: Pilar está desaparecida, Aurelio y la Felina la buscan. Aurelio da con Esperanza, ella llama a Salazar. Ninón se confiesa con su hijo, ve una foto del padre y descubre que hace negocios sucios.

programme.title: La frustración de Mónica
programme.desc: Tony y Mónica expresan su filosofía de vida y por qué se dedican al narcotráfico. Para ella la verdadera felicidad no existe. La Felina, preocupada por Pilar, la llama y otra persona responde.

programme.title: Casillas jura vengarse
programme.desc: Esperanza llama a Aurelio y pide que la deje en paz. Casillas la tilda de traidora por haberle "vendido" todo a la DEA. Jura venganza, es cuestión de tiempo. Tony quiere una vida con Mónica.

programme.title: Uzcátegui, en terreno movedizo
programme.desc: Aunque tiene el video de Rodrigo bajo la manga, Carla Uzcátegui quiere una entrevista con Rutila. Le dice lo que le gusta oír: la han perseguido, pero es un ejemplo para las mujeres del país.

programme.title: Una trampa para Aurelio
programme.desc: Tony está listo para liquidar a Aurelio. Mónica, sin saberlo, sirve de carnada. La Felina oye una propuesta. Leonardo insiste en hacerse cargo del negocio de Ninón. Los narcos preparan alianzas.

programme.title: La Felina no come cuentos
programme.desc: Eunice y Ninón, frente a frente en la morgue donde están los restos de Pilar. La Felina a punta de pistola amenaza con asesinarla, por haber liquidado a su amiga. Exige exámenes toxicológicos.

programme.title: Peligrosa atracción
programme.desc: Rutila y Javi se acercan más de la cuenta, acuerdan no mencionar a Aurelio Casillas. Mónica abandona a Tony, su único nexo será el negocio. La Felina tras la pista del celular de Pilar.

programme.title: De cara a la prensa
programme.desc: Rutila le concederá la entrevista a Uzcátegui, en la cual, promete hablar de todo. La Felina consigue pistas sobre Pilar y le pide a Aurelio que investigue más; pero sin la ayuda de Ninón.

programme.title: Examantes que negocian
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mónica tienen una cita cargada de sinceridad, nostalgia, reproches y traiciones, sollozan y beben. Él cede, pero no tanto. La Felina conoce a Leonardo, el punto débil de Ninón.

programme.title: Rastrean a Esperanza
programme.desc: Cuando Esperanza contacta a Ismael, rastrean la llamada. En España, Aurelio sigue deprimido tras la desaparición de Pilar; recuerda sus encuentros con Mónica y promete eliminar a Esperanza.

programme.title: Más que un mensajero
programme.desc: Javi lleva a Rutila el dinero que Aurelio le robó. Tienen un romance. Él la invita a Colombia. Ella no quiere nada serio con él, solo sexo, pero él está pensando en un compromiso.

programme.title: Torturan a Salazar
programme.desc: Penumbra le manda una foto de Salazar a Aurelio para que lo reconozca. El agente dice que dejen de perseguir a Esperanza, que ella no lo entregó, él la obligó. Lo torturan para que hable.

programme.title: Historia de una noche

programme.title: Ladrón que roba a ladrón

programme.title: Mujeres del Paraíso

programme.title: Una Luz en mi Camino
programme.desc: Un compositor ciego se enamora de una pobre sirvienta.

programme.title: No te engañes corazón
programme.desc: Una joven desea cantar ópera, pero su maestra la desanima, y, por otro lado, ama a su novio, pero su madre quiere casarla con un hombre viejo.

programme.title: El halcón solitario
programme.desc: Un comandante celebra la culminación de los estudios de su hermano, pero una banda de villanos rapta al profesional.

programme.title: El Farol de la Ventana
programme.desc: Un forastero se enamora de la hija de una mujer amnésica que cree que él es el hijo que el mar se llevó cuando era pequeño.

programme.title: Traigo mi 45
programme.desc: La novia de Francisco Reynoso busca la fama en la gran ciudad. Se adentra en un mundo peligroso, se junta con un grupo de delincuentes y encuentra un final trágico cuando su búsqueda de la fortuna la lleva a cometer un asesinato.

programme.title: Nosotras las sirvientas

programme.title: La diligencia de la muerte
programme.desc: Unos villanos asaltan una diligencia y el encargado de matar al cochero solo finge hacerlo y lo esconde en una cueva.

programme.title: La rosa blanca
programme.desc: Una producción cubana en homenaje al apóstol José Martí.

programme.title: El Amor a la Vida
programme.desc: Un extraño caminante llega exhausto a una hacienda y ayuda a la dueña a arreglar la situación legal de sus tierras.

programme.title: Luna de miel para nueve
programme.desc: Una pareja va a pasar su luna de miel en una cabaña y son invadidos por unos excursionistas que forman nuevas parejas.

programme.title: División narcóticos
programme.desc: Unos traficantes obligan a los campesinos de la frontera a sembrar amapola y amenazan de muerte a quién se niegue.

programme.title: Loco y vagabundo
programme.desc: Un vago llega a la capital y un hombre lo contrata para que se haga pasar por su hermano, pero un médico lo descubre.

programme.title: Tormenta en el Ring
programme.desc: Segunda y última película de la serie El Señor Tormenta compuesta de tres episodios: El Asesino, El Secuestro y la Lucha Final.

programme.title: Historia de un marido infiel

programme.title: Shredded Plane
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie receive an email with a photo of a shredded plane and must decide if it is genuine; they investigate if it was the propeller or another aircraft that was the cause.

programme.title: Helium Football
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test if helium-filled footballs can be thrown farther than ones filled with regular air.

programme.title: Franklin's Kite
programme.desc: The team investigates electricity and kites, in the style of Ben Franklin.

programme.title: Mind Control
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie cook up a DIY nightmare as they mix paint and dynamite for a home improvement myth; Grant, Tory and Kari find out if it's possible to manipulate someone's mind remotely; the mission is to remove Jamie's beret.

programme.title: Exploding Pants
programme.desc: The guys investigate whether a farmer's trousers can suddenly explode. Hosts: Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage.

programme.title: Killer Whirlpool
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie investigate killer whirlpools and the team gets snowplowed.

programme.title: Crimes and Myth-demeanors 2
programme.desc: Adam, Jamie and the team put the latest in security technology to the test.

programme.title: Shattering Subwoofer
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie find out if a stereo can be loud enough to destroy a car.

programme.title: Deadly Straw
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie find out if a hurricane can blow the feathers off a chicken.

programme.title: Earthquake Machine
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie build an earthquake machine in the manner of Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: Killer Cable Snaps
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test killer cable theories and the team looks into pottery.

programme.title: Concrete Glider
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie each try to make a glider out of concrete; the build team looks into whether one can get sucked out onto the train tracks if they stand too close to a passing train.

programme.title: Air Cylinder Rocket
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie find out if a compressed-air cylinder with a cracked valve can blast through a cinder block wall; Grant, Tory and Kari have a blast exploring if it's possible to get an engine running with gunpowder.

programme.title: More Myths Revisited
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam test the most controversial myths again to see if their original answers were correct.

programme.title: Exploding Lighter
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam explore the Exploding Lighter myth; they test whether a small, disposable butane lighter can ignite with the force of several dynamite sticks.

programme.title: Antigravity Device
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test the flammability of Christmas tree lights; Kari, Grant, and Tori test the claims of several antigravity devices.

programme.title: Firearms Folklore
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie test three gun-related myths, including one from "Saving Private Ryan;" Kari, Grant and Tori go to great lengths to see whether mankind's first and simplest tool could be far more dangerous.

programme.title: 22,000 Foot Fall
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie create the biggest explosion in MythBuster history.

programme.title: Holiday Special
programme.desc: The team investigates whether reindeer could help Santa fly and more.

programme.title: More Myths Reopened
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam revisit the most controversial myths; they repeat them to see if their original answer was genuine.

programme.title: Western Myths
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie saddle up for some western myths -- but that is not all.

programme.title: Big Rig Myths
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie try to find out if an exploding truck tire can kill.

programme.title: Grenades and Guts
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam investigate a grenade blast; will consuming diet soda and Mentos rupture a person's stomach?

programme.title: Snow Special
programme.desc: The team goes on the slopes to tackle snow myths; they try to determine if popping a whip can cause an avalanche.

programme.title: Viewer Special
programme.desc: The Mythbusters put a new batch of viewer suggestions to the test.

programme.title: Red Rag to a Bull
programme.desc: The team tests the "bull in a china shop" saying.

programme.title: Superhero Hour
programme.desc: The Marvel comic maestros are put under the MythBusters microscope.

programme.title: Myth Revolution
programme.desc: Kari, Tory and Grant put a radio-frequency identification conspiracy theory to the test; Adam and Jamie test two myths about weapons.

programme.title: Exploding Water Heater
programme.desc: Testing if an ordinary water heater has the ability to fly like a rocket, right through your house; this is a tale of explosive transformation.

programme.title: Shooting Fish in a Barrel
programme.desc: The MythBusters test the truth behind some time-honored sayings.

programme.title: Confederate Steam Gun
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam test a mythical steam-powered confederate weapon.

programme.title: James Bond Special- Part 1
programme.desc: The crew tests myths about James Bond-inspired gadgets, getaways and guns.

programme.title: Lead Balloon
programme.desc: The team tests if dynamite can create ideal surfing conditions and then tests the proverbial lead balloon.

programme.title: James Bond Special- Part 2
programme.desc: The Mythbusters dedicate this one-hour special to action hero James Bond.

programme.title: Viewer Special 2
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie open their inbox again; they test several myth-busting ideas from the fan site.

programme.title: Alaska Special
programme.desc: Alaska provides an ideal habitat to test some Alaskan anecdotes.

programme.title: NASA Moon Landing
programme.desc: The team tackles the tallest tale of all in Moon Landing Hoax Hour.

programme.title: Exploding Steak
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam try to tenderize steak with explosives; they test to see if a motorist uses more fuel when driving under stress.

programme.title: Ninjas 2
programme.desc: Jamie and Adam revisit some old ninja myths and tackle some new ones.

programme.title: Viral Hour
programme.desc: The team examines viral videos from the internet; they try to find out if people truly believe what they see.

programme.title: Water Stun Gun
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie try to turn a conventional electric stun gun into a water-powered electric stun gun.

programme.title: Alcohol Myths
programme.desc: Jamie, Adam and Kari apply science to the theory that the more they drink, the more attractive they find the opposite sex.

programme.title: Motorcycle Flip
programme.desc: Adam and Jamie take on an Indiana Jones movie stunt.

programme.title: That Highway is the Lifeline
programme.desc: Herb's team fights fire while tussling with a burned-out semi; as whiteouts rage across the 402 in Sarnia, Mark fights his way through a long backup to reach a job; a unique recovery crew faces a heavy load of peat moss and trailer ready to split.

programme.title: A Real Disaster

programme.title: I've seen my share

programme.title: You are never safe
programme.desc: Snow squalls attack Highway 402, sending Gary, Collin and Mark to work deep in the trees; a fuel tanker rolls next to rail lines in Toronto's industrial port lands; the Chatham crew improvises against a fire-ravaged wreck.

programme.title: Always makes my knee knock
programme.desc: Mitch's new partnership with his brother is put to the test in the aftermath of a brutal storm; Eric, Derek and crew take on a load of steel pipes threatening to spring loose on the road; Andrew and his team wrestle difficult cargo.

programme.title: Breaking and Entering
programme.desc: Will (Jude Law), a landscape architect in London, is in the middle of a life crisis. His relationship with Liv (Robin Wright Penn), a depressive Scandinavian, is going nowhere. A burglary at his office leads him to Amira (Juliette Binoche), a Bosnian refugee whose husband died in Sarajevo. Will is drawn to the vulnerable woman and initiates an affair.

However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: For the main course, all three chefs are cooking Welsh lamb in the hope of impressing the judge. Phil is taking a risk with barbecued lamb and in an attempt to elevate a humble barbecue to banquet level, he's serving it with many accompaniments.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges, so all three chefs are feeling the pressure. Phil Carmichael creates a tennis ball dessert that combines two British classics, Eton mess and trifle.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two winning chefs from the Wales region must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges and guest judge Dan Bloxham, Wimbledon's Master of Ceremonies.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Pip Lacey's starter is a humorous take on the unpredictable British weather and features an unusual presentation. Ryan Simpson's dish represents an allotment complete with soil, while Nick Deverell-Smith's creation is a tribute to the precision cutting of Wimbledon's grass.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: With the chefs hoping to impress, they each take risks. Pip Lacey combines lobster with strawberry in a tribute to strawberries and cream. Ryan Simpson's also using lobster in his recreation of a BBQ and has invented a technique to create his chips.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: Ryan Simpson hopes to elevate a ploughman's lunch into a gourmet affair, Pip Lacey pays tribute to an unusual Wimbledon icon, while Nick Deverell-Smith looks to celebrate a meat which he thinks is underused, venison.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges. Pip Lacey's pineapple dessert uses coriander. Nick Deverell-Smith also pays tribute to the pineapple, creating a dessert featuring a rice pudding made with couscous.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs who've made it through cook their four courses again. They must impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver and guest judge Jordanne Whiley, one of Britain's most successful wheelchair tennis players.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. Eddie is hoping to do better than last year, Joery is hoping to impress with a tribute to Richard Krajicek, and Tommy is creating a warm salad.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: Joery Castel is combining mackerel and cucumber, and Tommy Heaney hopes his Murray Mound is a fitting tribute to Andy Murray's love of sushi. Eddie Attwell is creating five different strawberry elements to accompany the scallops in his dish.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: Tommy Heaney's BBQ dish is a surf and turf combination, Joey Castle's aiming to recreate a more American-style BBQ and Eddie Attwell's taking a risk with unusual meat.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs who have made it through cook their four courses again. They are hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges, Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver, who are joined by tennis's greatest entertainer, Mansour Bahrami.

programme.title: Final Starter
programme.desc: With finals week ahead of them, judge Andi Oliver first summons the chefs to Wimbledon to have a look at where they could be cooking if they win. The judges are joined by guest judge Sue Barker, host of the Wimbledon coverage for more than 20 years.

programme.title: Final Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must cook their fish courses but with some exceptionally high scoring dishes in the regional heats, each chef will need to deliver perfection in order to see off the competition. The judges are joined by guest judge Tim Henman.

programme.title: Final Main
programme.desc: It is main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. As the barbecues are fired up, all eight chefs are feeling the heat. The judges are joined by guest judge Gordon Reid.

programme.title: Final Dessert
programme.desc: It is dessert day and with just one place remaining at the Wimbledon banquet, each chef is giving everything they have got. The judges are joined by guest judge Annabel Croft, former British number one and Junior Wimbledon champion.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale and the winning chefs must now cook their dishes at the banquet. Once in the kitchen, the chefs face the huge challenge of scaling up their dishes.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred 'House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: London South East Starter
programme.desc: Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred 'The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from 'The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

programme.title: London South East Fish
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.title: London South East Main
programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

programme.title: London South East Dessert
programme.desc: Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango purée filled doughnuts for his dessert 'Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: London South East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the south-east chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they remake their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision, gained from working at two-Michelin-starred restaurant 'Andrew Fairlie'.

programme.title: Scotland Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross seeks victory with his dish 'Lobster Aid'. Lorna's 'Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements.

programme.title: Scotland Main
programme.desc: Ross is hoping to impress with 'Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Ross is attempting to elevate a classic into a dish worthy of the banquet, Lorna is cooking a personal tribute to NHS staff using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours, and Ben is serving an experimental dish which includes a beeswax ice cream.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: It is judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness, and Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils, while Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and, following the previous day's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her 'carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat 'A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four-course menus.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his take on a traditional healing recipe, 'Mum's Flu-Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's 'A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed.

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's 'Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's 'For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with 'Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great-grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the south-west, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time. The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their celebratory starters.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head-to-head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking 'Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works night shifts in the NHS, while Ellis' 'Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish 'The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales, is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Wareing's two Michelin starred restaurant, and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head-to-head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Finals Starter
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.

programme.title: London and South East - Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

programme.title: London and South East Mains and Desserts
programme.desc: The three chefs are halfway through their heat and the pressure is mounting. Only two will proceed to Friday's judging and have a chance to represent the London and the South East region at the regional finals.

programme.title: London and South East - Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London chefs must cook their four-course menus again. The chefs need to impress the formidable judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North East: Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three chefs new to the competition compete in the North East heats. Three of the region's chefs battle it out for the top spot: Mike Carr, Samira Effa, and Tom Anglesea. The three chefs must present the menu of their careers, inspired by 50 years of British pop music.

programme.title: North East: Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high, and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, 'Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: North East: Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Central Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by grime music called 'Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called 'My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Central Main and Dessert
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: North West Starter and Fish
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: North West Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Scotland Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Smoke on the Water
programme.desc: The captains team up to double their chances, but forming an alliance with a competitor proves to be risky.

programme.desc: Captain Brad Krasowski is just one big catch away from completing his "worst to first" comeback.
